TO: Congress
FROM: Willis
Subject: Abolish the Electoral College now!

To the members of Congress,

**I am writing today to DEMAND that you abolish the Electoral College!**

Time and time again, Republicans have won the presidency despite LOSING the popular vote.

_Donald Trump wouldn’t have even won in the first place if it wasn’t for the Electoral College._

Every American’s vote should be counted equally. This system is TOTALLY UNDEMOCRATIC and UNFAIR!

**Thursday, November 26, 2026 -- Thanksgiving Day**
On Thanksgiving Day, time and space collide. We spend our days building, managing, and acquiring, arranging the world around us. But today, time claims the greater place. The things we have made and gathered become the setting; the time we give one another becomes the gift.
The table is set, a lovely sight reaching its fullness as the serving dishes arrive and the seats fill. Then perfection breaks. A stray crumb, an inevitable spill, a serving spoon borrowed from another dish. And in that breaking, something more beautiful emerges. Food is passed, stories unfold, laughter rises and lingers. We are nourished in ways no recipe can provide.
Afterward, plates move to the kitchen, leftovers are divided, hands find the sponge and towel. The conversation flows through the house. Some drift to the living room; one rests on the couch, all keeping the stories and laughter warm.
We invest our presence to reap a harvest no market can provide. The greatest reward is not what we acquire, but the time we give one another--and the grace to stay.
**Pause.
Breathe.
Look Deeper.**
**Refuel.**
**Welcome to Sweet Ground.**
* * *
**Send this Sweet Ground to another.**

Dear Patriot,

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwNzMsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAABF2qYrObPZc6tbnQvQxC7qThyQiX-mWqXLdEi6bZ3klF61aUlI75Ww9SC3uLB9vJdMG53GWzU67CZyXjNWtM2mTB4pFdw7ouo0-BD5JE

Six hundred thirty-nine thousand Americans.

That is how many people Jack Smith’s investigation pulled records on, according to findings that Senate Judiciary Chairman Chuck Grassley released on October 14. They include donors who gave as little as one dollar, and people whose only offense was buying a red hat.

I am preparing to take this to court.
https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwNzMsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAABF2qYrOcoCILiQdAvopmUD6cAFY-TV7A2Ih2o4Z4YsAsQemD3dIxPngqkTmw9eMo1xvP_xn8Pw-LlgKRzuyRr1IdIAyv6S4CfGwnmBxs
Help me drag Jack Smith’s dragnet into the light.

Here is what Senator Grassley says was sitting in those files: names, birth dates, occupations and credit card information. The records reached nearly 150,000 political donors, and they included one spreadsheet listing the people who bought “Make America Great Again” hats after the 2020 election.

Think about who is sitting in that pile. Maybe it was a retired schoolteacher who gave ten dollars after a rally, or a veteran who bought a hat for his grandson’s birthday. Maybe it was a farmer who chipped in a single dollar because he was tired of being ignored by Washington. Everybody knows somebody who gave, and any one of them could be sitting in a federal file right now without the faintest idea.

Did you know we have an official JanePAC merch store?? 👀

**[SHOP TODAY ››](https://act.janepac.com/go/106?utm_source=em20261127-65&t=4&akid=65%2E6803%2E4HHhlc)**
_Resist_ isn’t just a catchphrase or a slogan for Jane. It’s something she practices every day, whether she’s standing up to the Trump administration or taking on Big Oil or reminding the media that electing climate champions matters.
And making that message visible wherever we go is a huge part of bringing more people into our movement.
Think about it: **a t-shirt can spark a conversation with a stranger. A conversation can turn into a new friendship. And that friendship can inspire someone to join our fight for a livable future.**
When we wear our values on our sleeves (literally!), we’re reminding the world that the many can beat the money.
That’s exactly what we proved in the midterms, and we’re determined to do it again next year, but that means we’ve got to start laying the groundwork NOW. Yes, sometimes that starts with something as simple as a t-shirt or a sticker!
**[So, as a thank you for being one of our top grassroots supporters this year, we’d like to offer you an exclusive discount. Use promo code “THANKYOU26” to get 15% off your order today! Every item is made in the USA and union-printed.](https://act.janepac.com/go/106?utm_source=em20261127-65&t=5&akid=65%2E6803%2E4HHhlc)**
**[SHOP TODAY ››](https://act.janepac.com/go/106?utm_source=em20261127-65&t=6&akid=65%2E6803%2E4HHhlc)**
Every purchase helps fund our work and keeps our fight visible.
Thank you,
Team JanePAC
**Before you go...** We couldn’t be prouder of this movement. 226 climate champions elected. Over 55 seats flipped. But the fossil fuel industry isn't taking a day off, and neither can we. name: Redemption arc:
subject: “Louisiana is the one Democrats let slip away”
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pat Moore for Congress
body:
But this December 12 we get a rare second chance to win in Louisiana and flip a red US House seat blue.
| | | [](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001hd5pQHlTc76RzH-r0V3_vlkDpOT7KxfnU1F6kUewc-37viVmG97Uq8VEghpcuS9j62UKId1TFAdmG9QVf41A8WGdPsExzoySHV8iDmTChJlAdo0DJLTX_V251lx6fD5xl3TtSMnEwfI8C-QpOMhPZ84JUzqfcNAmCnYWhyxjGHuSgR2MiVL6payI8Rka3fcIghCVRMZ2b-U2zXh7B1MzGcpK6LrDLJHNTHOGQ25KWRw=&c=rdIpK4AteBVNvptKv1wiIJSDQ06cqRKsFGR7oKu5ib6hx_bBcGoGNA==&ch=AKgawnoklYg7To9OAfc15yJnbAJvMiMBry54CyyviMIQaDBlkJMMJA==)
---
Friend,
On November 3, Democrats barely missed flipping Louisiana’s open US Senate seat blue—**falling short by only 25,000 votes, or less than 1.8%.**
Dem farmer Jamie Davis ran an outstanding grassroots campaign and fought hard to win. But in a fateful decision, _national Dems refused to support._
Jamie’s narrow loss has many wondering what could have happened with national and outside support helping push Dem and Black turnout even higher.

We want to emphasize that our goal is never to disrupt or clutter your inbox. Every email sent is intended to provide value, and we genuinely appreciate your time and attention. This November, voters sent a clear message.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20261127-6988-footer&t=1&akid=6988%2E420207%2EHEZh86)
Peter,
This November, voters sent a clear message. They don’t want small fixes. They want big change.
They’re tired of paying sky-high premiums to insurance companies that deny their care. They’re tired of working full-time and still falling behind on rent. They’re tired of a government that answers to billionaires instead of working people.
**So here’s my message to my fellow Democrats: we cannot go back to business as usual.**
For too long, Democrats have been content to be the opposition party. But opposing Trump isn’t enough. We need to be a proposition party — we need to stand for something and then actually deliver it.
That means Medicare For All, so that no one goes bankrupt because they got sick. It means a federal living wage, so that anyone working full time can afford a roof over their head. It means taxing the rich, protecting Social Security, and making sure working families get their fair share.
But make no mistake: corporate lobbyists, Big Pharma, and right-wing billionaires are already working to water down our agenda before we even get started. They'll tell us to be "realistic." They'll tell us to play it safe.
**I refuse.**
The only way we beat their money is with people power. I don't take a dime from corporate PACs, and I don't have billionaires on speed dial. I count on grassroots supporters like you, pitching in a few bucks at a time.
[**Our end-of-month deadline is Monday night. So if you’re ready to help me keep pushing for bold, progressive change, will you chip in $3 or any amount today to help us meet our goal?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20261127.A8meWf&refcode=em20261127-6988&amount=3&t=2&akid=6988%2E420207%2EHEZh86)

Thank you, thank you, thank you for your support.

Pramila Jayapal

They’re tired of paying sky-high premiums to insurance companies that deny their care. They’re tired of working full-time and still falling behind on rent. They’re tired of a government that answers to billionaires instead of working people. So here’s my message to my fellow Democrats: we cannot go back to business as usual. For too long, Democrats have been content to be the opposition party. But opposing Trump isn’t enough. We need to be a proposition party — we need to stand for something and then actually deliver it. That means Medicare For All, so that no one goes bankrupt because they got sick. It means a federal living wage, so that anyone working full time can afford a roof over their head. It means taxing the rich, protecting Social Security, and making sure working families get their fair share. But make no mistake: corporate lobbyists, Big Pharma, and right-wing billionaires are already working to water down our agenda before we even get started. They'll tell us to be "realistic." They'll tell us to play it safe. I refuse. The only way we beat their money is with people power. I don't take a dime from corporate PACs, and I don't have billionaires on speed dial. I count on grassroots supporters like you, pitching in a few bucks at a time. Thank you, thank you, thank you for your support. In solidarity, Pramila Jayapal | | Email us: info@pramilaforcongress.com

# Friday, November 27, 2026

**Good Morning, and happy Black Friday!** We hope you had a wonderful Thanksgiving. If you're reading this over coffee and a slice of leftover pie, pull up your Christmas list. Take a look at some top picks from the **2026 Flyover Gift Guide**. For the golfer who'd happily spend every Saturday on the course, **Pins & Aces** has golf bags, polos, and headcovers that give their clubs a little personality. For the family that keeps the party going long after dinner, the **Singing Machine Karaoke** set might be the first gift out of its box on Christmas morning. And for the gardener who's already counting down to spring, **Gardyn Indoor Gardens** lets them grow greens right in the kitchen. Need something smaller? The **Roamora Travel Vacuum Kit** makes room in a carry-on for the person who always packs one more outfit. And **FlightPath Golf Tees** are an easy stocking stuffer for the golfer who's already booked their next tee time. We've rounded up more favorites below, and you'll find even more **Gifts Under the Tree** and **Stocking Stuffers** in the full guide. Here's hoping you get to cross a few names off your list before the pie is gone. _What do all of these folks have in common?_
**They're all grassroots donors who chipped in to this historic campaign. And thanks to people just like them, we're building the largest Democratic campaign this district has EVER seen.**

Sunday was our big FEC reporting day, and thanks to folks like you, we hit our fundraising goal.
In one of the reddest districts in America, a campaign powered by welders and teachers and janitors just did what the experts said couldn't be done. No billionaire bankrolled it, and I refuse Corporate PAC money (and I always will). Working people from every corner of this country powered the movement. Not the powerful few.
**_But I'd be doing you a disservice if I let you think the job is finished._**
That deadline was just the first milestone. Now we have to get back to work, because flipping this seat means turning out every Democrat and independent. And we only have until December 12 to do it.
15 days. That's all that stands between us and electing the first Black woman Louisiana has EVER sent to Congress.
If you've already given, thank you from the bottom of my heart. And if you haven't yet, there's never been a better time to join the welder, the doctor, the teacher, and the janitor.

body:
If Republicans want to win in 2028, they need to remember the advice from Abraham Lincoln about listening to voters.

---
| | |
---
| Friend, [More than 160 years ago, Abraham Lincoln warned that _**“with public sentiment, nothing can fail; without it nothing can succeed”...**_](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJycks2u2yAUhJ8G74gMOBAvvKhqReridhXdLhGGY-dINlj8OO3bVyS5fYDu0Gj0zTA6vz70h8EV_fLTbDDYA3VM-nE3eUVvw-ofoawuwobelZQ1b7mkjFGutLEZD9CscYN1UvAGBqb6s7pIztrmPjDJOjVJZkRveDtP8-TU3HdTB2c7K8saHCqNMa6YEG2rTlPveM8MTLMzl85I0rVldyZDOtngE8TD1Ej0PtRX8CcbtmYd7jnviYhvhF8JvyawJcLpgT6Cqw7Crz4mS_j12X4PKVNYwVYCTSUe8If6Bf0S0d4p0N1UkLiWvOkNHJaNiBE2gyvhsorZEjF-__xBv_q_9RRKtEDEGPimK-WpWrPtBhdPxFj9Nf4r_RX-Xpr6Rf-roV-NX4DgM_hMxDgX76LBhH4hXJot7yFhBRExdi-lI2JkbUu4jHWHWK1izLEA4RJ-64zuXYQx1uvbjX7eToyp7tLrzNvLpZeMntW5iYPbH7iumKQiXbvU_z_3zv93JcfA_wYAAP__BFrOmw) In 2026, too many Republicans forgot the rule that built our party in the first place. Somewhere along the way, people who had been doing a pretty good job of listening to the American people decided they knew better than the voters who elected them. I've watched this party come back from the wilderness before.

It took 16 years of hard work to break the Democrats' 40-year grip on the House in 1994, and we did it by asking the American people what problems they wanted solved and then going out and solving them.

That's the Lincoln model, and it starts with you.

body:
[ stdin# ]Josh Shapiro for Pennsylvania
Derek, we want to
make sure you saw this:

In 53 days, Josh Shapiro will be sworn in for his second term as
Pennsylvania’s 48th Governor — but before he takes the oath of office, he
wants to hear from you.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/survey/democratic-trifecta-priorities-survey/?t=1001&akid=982%2E245147%2E7lUXlo ]We want to know what’s on your mind as we prepare for another term of
getting stuff done. Will you fill out our Democratic Trifecta Priorities
Survey before the end of the week?

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/survey/democratic-trifecta-priorities-survey/?t=1002&akid=982%2E245147%2E7lUXlo ]Take the Survey →

We want at least three more responses from
Cresco
before we go over the results with Josh on Monday — and
Derek, we hope we can count on
you to make your voice heard.

Thank you,

Team Shapiro

------ Begin Forwarded Message ------

Derek,

58 days from today, I’ll stand on the steps of the Pennsylvania State
Capitol on a frigid Tuesday morning in Harrisburg and take the oath of
office to serve a second term as Pennsylvania’s 48th Governor.

Trust me, I wish I could talk to each
Pennsylvanian
individually over the next 58 days — to hear what you have to say, to
understand what’s top-of-mind to you and your family, to know exactly what
you want our historic Democratic trifecta to accomplish.

Unfortunately, personal conversations with over 13 million Pennsylvanians
in less than two months is... a bit of a tall order. So I wanted to do the
next best thing.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/survey/democratic-trifecta-priorities-survey/?t=1003&akid=982%2E245147%2E7lUXlo ]My team and I just released our brand-new Democratic Trifecta
Priorities Survey — so we know exactly what to prioritize the moment we’re
sworn into office. We need at least three more responses from
Cresco
to bring in a representative sample. Please, will you take just two
minutes to fill it out? Every response helps our team more than you can
imagine.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/survey/democratic-trifecta-priorities-survey/?t=1004&akid=982%2E245147%2E7lUXlo ]Take the Survey →

Appreciate the help!

Josh Shapiro

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a critical way we communicate with supporters like you.
Unsubscribe: https://act.joshshapiro.org/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1005&akid=982%2E245147%2E7lUXlo

[PAID FOR BY SHAPIRO FOR PENNSYLVANIA]

Peter, 455 days ago, Texas became the first domino to fall. In an attempt to flip five seats in Congress, and under the directive of Donald Trump, Republican Governor Greg Abbott signed an extreme, racial gerrymander into law that would set off a national redistricting crisis. The voters of Texas didn’t like that. Let’s take a look back at how it all turned out for Republicans in the Lone Star State... ✅ After decades of Republican rule, voters in Texas turned the page in the midterms, electing our endorsed Democracy Defender Gina Hinojosa to become their first Democratic governor since 1994. ✅ NDRC helped Democrats in Texas flip the state House — a historic win that will now be a key line of defense against any attempt to further gerrymander the state. Over 40 of our Democracy Defenders won their races in the chamber. ✅ The new gerrymander didn’t work. Republicans had hoped that it would guarantee five additional GOP seats in Congress, but voters had the final say, and Republicans lost one instead. What happened in Texas should be a warning to any Republican hoping to manipulate maps to secure power. But despite voters overwhelmingly rejecting these tactics in the midterms, Republicans in some states are set on gerrymandering before the next election. ## How to Make an Event Repeat on Your Apple Calendar
### System Requirements
_This tip was performed on an iPhone 18 Pro running iOS 26.2. Find out how to update to the[latest version of iOS](https://click.iphonelife.com/ga/click/2-17209627-5-17276-262622-8943622-7995282aea-apf8526ef0)._
Have a recurring meeting or event you don't want to forget? It's easy to set up recurring calendar events and [color-code them](https://click.iphonelife.com/ga/click/2-17209627-5-17276-262622-8943623-3c94e758f6-apf8526ef0) with your iPad or iPhone Calendar, ensuring you can stay organized and on time for every appointment. Here's how to add a recurring event to your Apple Calendar:
1. Open the **Calendar app**.

---
2. Find the event you want to edit, or create a new event by pressing the **plus** icon.

---

3. If you selected an existing event, tap **Edit**. If you created a new event, skip to Step 4.

---

4. Tap the date and time under the event title.

---
5. Enter the date and time when the event **Starts** and **Ends**.

---
6. Toggle on **All-day** if the event lasts all day.

---
7. Tap **Never** next to **Repeat** to select how often you would like the event to recur.

---
8. Tap the **Repeat** option that best fits your event. In this case, **Every Week**.

---
9. If this is a repeat event that will eventually end, tap **Never** next to **End Repeat**.

---
10. Tap **After** or **On Date**.

---
11. If you choose **After** , you can use the plus and minus signs to determine how many times your calendar event will repeat before it ends.

---
12. If you choose **On Date** , your calendar will automatically set the end date for one month after the initial event. Tap the **date** to manually select the end date. You'll have the option to choose a date when the event will stop repeating.

---
13. Tap the check mark in the red circle**** in the upper right corner when you have finished personalizing the rest of your calendar event options.

---

That's how to make an event repeat on your Apple Calendar. Now you'll be notified of this recurring event on the schedule that you selected. If you set a date to end the repeating event, once your chosen date passes, the Calendar app will stop sending you notifications about the event. Alternatively, you can also simply [delete the event](https://click.iphonelife.com/ga/click/2-17209627-5-17276-262622-8943626-2fec7cf41d-apf8526ef0) when you no longer need to be reminded about it. You can also [link your calendars](https://click.iphonelife.com/ga/click/2-17209627-5-17276-262622-8943627-1a7edc8b39-apf8526ef0) to prevent events from overlapping.
Be sure to check out our free [Tip of the Day](https://click.iphonelife.com/ga/click/2-17209627-5-17276-262622-8943628-05f045c328-apf8526ef0) for more great Calendar app tutorials.

subject: Our message to Amazon on Black Friday

body:
[ stdin# ]Our Revolution Logo

Peter Willis,

This Black Friday, Amazon will be working overtime to get millions of
people to shop on its platform. But while the company cashes in on one of
the biggest shopping weekends of the year, it's also fighting to escape
accountability for its monopoly abuses.

Last month, Amazon asked a federal judge to dismiss parts of a landmark
antitrust lawsuit brought by the Federal Trade Commission and state
attorneys general. With a trial scheduled for March 2027, Amazon is
already trying to weaken a case that could finally hold one of the most
powerful corporations in the world accountable.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/40194?source=email-20261127&t=1011&akid=11640%2E5885482%2EPXtNML ]Amazon must face trial.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/40194?source=email-20261127&t=1012&akid=11640%2E5885482%2EPXtNML ]Headline: U.S. sues Amazon in a monopoly case that could be existential
for the retail giant

We refuse to allow Amazon to use its power to escape a trial.

The FTC has a chance to make Amazon answer for its practices in court. Now
we need to overwhelm them with public pressure not to drop the case,
weaken its demands, or settle for a deal that lets the company off the
hook.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/40194?source=email-20261127&t=1013&akid=11640%2E5885482%2EPXtNML ]This Black Friday, will you send a message to the FTC demanding that
Amazon's antitrust case go to trial?

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/40194?source=email-20261127&t=1014&akid=11640%2E5885482%2EPXtNML ]ADD YOUR NAME

Black Friday is a reminder of just how much power Amazon has over the way
Americans shop.

But Amazon's dominance affects far more than what shows up in your
shopping cart. Its enormous market power shapes the rules of commerce,
putting pressure on workers, squeezing small businesses, and limiting
competition. This case could help break Amazon's stranglehold on the
economy and establish an important precedent for reining in Big Tech
monopolies.

At Our Revolution, we're fighting back, organizing to pressure our leaders
for an economy that works for ALL of us — not just concentrated wealth and
power in the hands of a few. It should work for the workers who make the
goods, the small businesses trying to compete, and the families doing
their best to make ends meet.

That's why we're joining the Amazon Labor Union – IBT Local 1 and The
Labor Force in building a nationwide coalition to demand accountability.
Together, we're making sure regulators hear one clear message: Amazon must
face trial.

Amazon has the money, the lawyers, and the influence to fight this case at
every turn. What it shouldn't have is a free pass. And it's going to take
all of us speaking out to keep up the pressure.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/40194?source=email-20261127&t=1015&akid=11640%2E5885482%2EPXtNML ]While Amazon is counting on record Black Friday sales, let's make sure
regulators know the public is demanding accountability. Add your name and
tell them: don't back down. Make Amazon face trial.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/40194?source=email-20261127&t=1016&akid=11640%2E5885482%2EPXtNML ]ADD YOUR NAME

When we organize, we win.

Our Revolution

Six hundred thirty-nine thousand Americans.

That is how many people Jack Smith’s investigation pulled records
on, according to findings that Senate Judiciary Chairman Chuck
Grassley released on October 14. They include donors who gave as
little as one dollar, and people whose only offense was buying a red
hat.

I am preparing to take this to court. Help me drag Jack Smith’s
dragnet into the light.
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e845213/UaHR0cHM6Ly9mcmVlZG9td2F0Y2gucmV2di5jby9mdy02MzkwMDAtbWItb20v/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjExMjc/LbmNsbnpCU1FhbQ/qP3V0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1tYiZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPW9tJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZnctNjM5MDAwJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PTMwZCZ1dG1fdGVybT0yMzkzN193cjFd/gawmSAg/s1k3d78f4e2

Here is what Senator Grassley says was sitting in those files: names,
birth dates, occupations and credit card information. The records
reached nearly 150,000 political donors, and they included one
spreadsheet listing the people who bought “Make America Great
Again” hats after the 2020 election.

Think about who is sitting in that pile. Maybe it was a retired

GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE

Friend,

The call blasted across the police radio: "We need backup—NOW!"

Officers ran. Inside a tiny shack, they found two sisters.

One was five years old; the other was twenty months – still a baby.

Both were tied by their ankles… and hanging upside down from the roof.

I'll call them Ana and Lucia. Those are not their real names. But this is their true story.

One officer reached for the baby first and began cutting her down.

Ana was still hanging beside her, waiting.

She didn't scream; she didn't kick or cry or fight the rope. She just watched.

To her, this was normal.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwNzMsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAABGJCzmN7r6aFe6-VBrT2u065kbD9IFSTeEmfp-H3rsRy2LLBRMLVri-Iz5ohUffGeCt98OpWZ2Co7_u6_Hme46YXZz8hId_VYqvK-TqJ
Help Protect the Next Children Like Ana and Lucia

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwNzMsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAABGJCzmN8e0ELpQst0Q0LUdGxFqIPR1hXAKOrg62aPyJk0h1QFSrJkLL8wap5fjJW9fSBs9iVJDbcvz0yP_1z5EdAsIyDsRbsmZRuELbb

Friend, I have heard many rescue stories since the movie Sound of Freedom came out.

This is one I cannot shake.

Ana and Lucia had been hurt by the very adults who were supposed to protect them. Hurt in ways I cannot – will not – describe to you.

The ropes had cut deep into their ankles. Those marks would become scars.

But that day, everything changed.

SOMEONE noticed. SOMEONE made the call. And SOMEONE answered.

The officers carried both girls out of that shack.

They were placed in a safe home through our program partner, House Parent Project.

Now let me tell you what happened next.

For more than three years, their house parents have fed them, tucked them in, and prayed over them every night.

They have watched Ana and Lucia heal... grow... and laugh.

Both girls go to school now. And little by little, they have learned something no child should ever have to learn:

Hands are meant to protect. Not hurt.

Today, they are thriving.

And Friend, here is the part that makes me want to drop to my knees in thanks…

A loving family has stepped forward to adopt them.

Both of them. Together.

That family is going through the approval process right now.

subject: I’m facing 17 years in prison
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
The Trump administration’s Department of Justice is trying to send me to prison for up to 17 years.

**November 27, 2026**
On January 6, 2021, Senator Marco Rubio addressed the Senate. His words were a reminder of what can be lost when politics becomes the measure of everything.
"I think politics has made us crazy. Everybody in this country has lost their minds on politics, and we have forgotten that America is not a government, America is not a President, America is not a Congress.
"Let me tell you what America is. America is your family. America is your faith. America is your community. That is America. That is what our adversaries don't understand, and that is what we need to remember. That is how we are going to rebuild this country and turn the page and have a future even brighter than our past."
We can argue over who gets to lead America, who gets to speak for America, and who gets to claim America.
But no election, no president, and no Congress can do the work of a family, build the trust of a neighbor, or teach the next generation what is worth preserving.
**Pause.
Breathe.
Look Deeper.**
**Refuel.**
**Welcome to Sweet Ground.**

prosecutor herself said it is “pretty clear” we did not intend to
vote. Still, the two counts together carry up to 10 years in prison
and $20,000 in fines.

Friend, American taxpayers have invested billions of dollars into SpaceX’s Starlink and Starshield satellite networks to provide vital, military-grade communications on the battlefield.
Yet, following a conversation between Elon Musk and Donald Trump, Ukraine’s access to these critical systems was abruptly degraded without warning – just as Russia unleashed a barrage of ballistic missiles and drone strikes.
By capping connection speeds for fast-moving platforms, the restriction crippled Ukrainian interceptor drones and disabled missions across an entire military theater.
Since then, the public has been fed a web of conflicting excuses: Elon Musk claims the U.S. government controls Starshield, Donald Trump denies ordering any limits, and Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth points back to SpaceX. Meanwhile, Ukrainian forces on the frontlines continue to suffer the consequences of degraded battlefield communications.
**No single billionaire or private corporation should have the unchecked power to tamper with taxpayer-funded military technology.** And Donald Trump’s ambivalence toward Ukraine’s survival has enabled Elon Musk to interfere with how America supports a key democratic ally.
The events in Ukraine reveal a dangerous national security vulnerability: a single point of control that can be turned against the forces that depend on it. If SpaceX can unilaterally throttle or alter satellite services for an ally in the middle of a war, what stops them from exposing U.S. troops to similar disruptions in the future?
**That is why I launched a formal Senate Permanent Subcommittee on Investigations inquiry into SpaceX and the Department of Defense, demanding full transparency on who ordered this slowdown, what contractual safeguards exist, and why the Pentagon has allowed itself to become solely dependent on one company.**
[**_Before we take the next steps in our investigation, I want to hear directly from you: Do you approve of Elon Musk’s influence over taxpayer-funded military communications? Take a moment to weigh in now._**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/144141783/662547971/-595467842?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&ask=5&code=jtk1509-su-nd1&refcode=jtk1509-su-nd1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM3OTQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMjE2OWE0YTItN2JlYS1mMTExLTkxZjMtMDAwZDNhNTMzMTliIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Jlk8Nc-tv9QShoifCZkS2pep0xZncJeaE_SbmJhA89M=&emci=0adc550f-13e8-f111-91f3-000d3a533978&emdi=2169a4a2-7bea-f111-91f3-000d3a53319b&ceid=9329426)

FOX 23 reports some returning Senate Democrats, and most incoming freshmen, haven't publicly backed Schumer.

"Well, look, the big investigation, I think the big investigation has to be Minnesota, and the people are calling for it. Corruption," Trump told a reporter at Mar-a-Lago. "They want us to solve the problem where Minnesota, you know, the Somalians and others stole billions and billions of dollars. That's big money. California, Maine, Minnesota, numerous states, they stole big money, and we're going to get to the bottom of it." (The exchange is on the .) Eagle-eyed readers will recall that I recently explained how the Trump White House, without Republican Sen. Susan Collins standing in the way, would now be unrestrained in how ruthlessly it enforced Maine's serial and flagrant violations of federal welfare rules: "[A] less obvious consequence of Collins' retirement: The Trump White House no longer has any reason to hold back from hammering Maine's compliance with federally funded welfare programs. That hammer is coming." How did Maine "steal" from the federal government? Well, contrary to the belief of many Democrat lawmakers and bureaucrats, federal dollars don't rain from the sky to nourish corrupt state governments without a few strings attached. One such string, courtesy of Republican lawmakers, is that federal Medicaid welfare dollars cannot be spent on non-citizens. Some states, like Maine, insist on giving third-world "New Americans" access to welfare anyways. But they have to pay for it with state tax dollars. So when Maine gives five-star health care to the military-aged man who crossed the border five months ago and refuses to work, the cost of that care has to come directly from Mainers -- not the federal government. As we know, Maine is host to tens of thousands of non-citizens who are riding the MaineCare Express. If DHHS paid for all that "free" welfare and then attempted to reimburse the state with federal dollars... that would amount to stealing. The question is, then, did Maine steal from the Feds to pay for non-citizen welfare? Let's go to Department of Health and Human Services (DHHS) commissioner Sarah Gagne-Holmes for a clue. As DHHS and Gov. Janet Mills' administration were contemplating how to respond to an inquiry from the House Oversight Committee about exactly this question, Gagne-Holmes had this to : "the goal here is to avoid a congressional subpoena." | | ---|---|--- Oddly, this is one email, obtained via a Freedom of Access Act request, that you'll never see in Pulse Marketing's news blog or the new sites paid for by George Soros and Hansjorg Wyss. | | | | | | | ---|---|--- | Nov 24 | The logical conclusion from Gagne-Holmes' desire to avoid a congressional subpoena is that a congressional subpoena would find material that would be, at best, embarrassing, and, at worst, incriminating. Then consider the broader context: Maine has reluctantly suspended more than 30 providers from MaineCare for credible allegations of fraud -- providers who've collectively billed more than $150 million. And that's just the tip of the iceberg. For whatever reason, the vast majority of those providers just happen to be "New Mainers." Trump has said something similar once before. On Sept. 3 at the White House, as we reported, he said, "If you look at California, if you look at Minnesota, if you look at Maine -- who would think Maine?" and "Maine is bad." Just how bad is Maine? We're about to find out, and you'll learn it first from The Robinson Report. Subscribe free at RobinsonReport.Substack.com. The homeless shelter CEOs keep putting the profit in non-profit... Mid-Maine Homeless Shelter and Services CEO Katie Spencer White was arrested Nov. 20 in Brunswick. The charges are witness tampering, a Class C felony, and obstruction of government administration. Police allege shelter leadership interfered with a probe that began Aug. 22, when a resident reported missing methadone. It was reportedly found in a dumpster two days later, and the shelter says it was thrown out by accident. She is out on bail and barred from the shelter she has run since 2019. The money: the shelter's 2024 Form 990 reports $2,745,749 in revenue (reported) and $138,966 in total compensation for White, which our story says is up about 64 percent since she took over. Waterville's council approved redirecting $200,000 in federal pandemic money to operating costs in 2024, and White has said the shelter received a $700,000 MaineHousing grant. The board hasn't said whether she is still on the payroll, on leave, or who is paying her lawyers. On Tuesday we posted a photo of an official-looking sign outside the ICE facility in Scarborough. It read "Tax Sponsored Abduction and Murder," and we asked whether Scarborough supports a sign like that on official town infrastructure. Our posts said ICE had noticeably increased security on its perimeter since armed protesters started showing up. By early afternoon, the sign had been removed by DPW. One way to shrink a budget problem is to forecast your way out of it. On Tuesday the Revenue Forecasting Committee raised its projections for General Fund revenue by about $388.2 million over the 2028-2029 biennium, plus $126.7 million in one-time money this fiscal year. Both match the committee's . The Maine Center for Economic Policy, a progressive group funded by George Soros and tightly allied to the Maine People's Alliance, figures the General Fund structural gap could drop from about $1.1 billion to $551 million -- which is about as likely as the Department of Marine Resources discovering a shipwreck on Georges Bank with $100 billion in gold doubloons hidden inside. The state's Sept. 30 forecast had put the gap at $1.085 billion for the General Fund and $256.7 million for the Highway Fund, about $1.34 billion combined. Central Maine Power wants about $189 million a year more in distribution revenue (requested in April). The Public Utilities Commission estimates that works out to about $11.06 more a month for the average household, and the increase still needs the commission's sign-off. The state's ratepayer advocate wants a look at a whistleblower's paper trail first. The commission agreed Nov. 20 to let the Office of the Public Advocate ask for records connected to a Connecticut lawsuit filed by Andrew Jacobs, who was chief compliance officer at CMP's parent company, Avangrid Networks. In that lawsuit Jacobs alleges managers told him to hold back information from federal auditors, minimize what he described as a bribery issue involving CMP, and overstate how well the company complied with the rules. He says he lost his job for cooperating with the auditors. CMP says a 2025 incident of about $39,000 in disputed expenses, some of them unauthorized credit card charges, has no effect on what customers pay. The deadline for information requests was Nov. 24, and CMP's responses are due Dec. 8. In October the commission turned down CMP's bid for about $69 million in temporary rates while the case goes on. A separate increase hits default-supply customers Jan. 1: about $4.99 a month for a household using 550 kilowatt-hours. Outside the post office at Forest Avenue and Preble Street in Portland, Jon Fetherston has watched people slump on the sidewalk next to discarded syringes. On Monday he put the question he keeps asking Maine cops who revive the same person twice to White House drug czar Sara Carter: once Narcan works, who walks that person into treatment? Carter's answer: the administration wants hospitals to hand patients directly to care, a 30-day program first and longer treatment after. She named no Maine location or start date. On illegal marijuana grows she called shutdown a top federal priority and said federal drug trafficking teams and Homeland Security Investigations are working on Maine. No timeline there either. She interviewed me about those grows nearly three years ago. Her message to parents who have lost children: "I will be your warrior to save our kids." MaineHousing and Project Home will stop taking new Eviction Prevention Program applications at 5 p.m. Monday, Nov. 30. They expect the waitlist already in hand to use up the money, and applying by the deadline doesn't guarantee help. Applications opened Sept. 21 on a one-time $11 million state allocation (appropriated), per MaineHousing's . Households that are behind on rent and earn no more than 60 percent of the area median can have the back rent paid to their landlord, plus up to 12 months of help afterward, capped at $9,600 per household (the most the program will pay). Project Home says its partnership with MaineHousing has helped 1,439 households avoid eviction (aka get free rent) since the program launched in 2024. Citizenship is not a requirement to qualify. A Maine mother can't take her daughter to church without the girl's father's approval, and Liberty Counsel has now petitioned the U.S. Supreme Court to review it. The petition challenges a Maine Supreme Judicial Court ruling that left the father with final say over the child's religious activities. The state court's Sept. 1 decision rests on findings about the child's anxiety and a 2024 church service in which the pastor, over about six and a half minutes, named the family almost 30 times and called the custody fight an attack on God's word. The court said it did not find Christianity harmful to the child. In its telling, the harm came from the parents' failure to cooperate and from messages at church that put the girl at odds with her father. Liberty Counsel says the order stops the mother from sharing her faith during her own parenting time. Mat Staver, its founder, says the decision "abandons the constitutional safeguards that protect parental rights and religious liberty." The Maine Drug Enforcement Agency arrested three Connecticut men Tuesday after a monthlong investigation with undercover cocaine-base purchases. Agents allegedly seized 728 grams of cocaine, 5.9 grams of fentanyl, $1,431 in cash and a handgun, with a street value MDEA puts at about $70,000. Emory Hames, 54, of Windsor, Allan Jackson, 58, and Zackery Franklin, 59, both of New Haven, are charged with aggravated trafficking, and Jackson with possessing a firearm as a prohibited person. The counts are conspiracy to distribute drugs, distribution, and possessing a firearm as a felon. Between July and October 2024 he sold cocaine, fentanyl and more than 500 grams of methamphetamine to an FBI informant, and a search of his home turned up 10 firearms. The drug charge carries a 10-year mandatory minimum and up to life, with a fine of up to $10 million. The firearm charge carries up to 15 years. # [China at 20%, Vietnam up to 35%: the new tariff list](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=11677714&post_id=226804415&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjI2ODA0NDE1LCJpYXQiOjE3OTU3OTg1NzUsImV4cCI6MTc5ODM5MDU3NSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTExNjc3NzE0Iiwic3ViIjoicG9zdC1yZWFjdGlvbiJ9.sEKbIRJk32TsqyqnITcwnlmxD3gmTiNiBBukCwJOpMc)

---|---|---
#### From Our Partners
## **[$1,000 in Starbucks became roughly $390,000](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/be20dace-e0e4-41c5-a98e-27cdaf9e697c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
### 1992 - Starbucks goes public. Split-adjusted, a share costs about **27 cents**.
* * *
### 2026 - It trades above $100, nearly **400 times higher**. A $1,000 stake on day one would be worth roughly **$390,000**.
* * *
### Now \- A Colombian coffee company with its own farms, the North American rights to Juan Valdez® and **3,000+ stores** is still at the **pre-IPO stage**. **[See the company.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/be20dace-e0e4-41c5-a98e-27cdaf9e697c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/be20dace-e0e4-41c5-a98e-27cdaf9e697c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Starbucks won the cafe.
_The next winner may own the farm._
Most coffee brands never touch a coffee tree. They buy processed beans from middlemen and fight over whatever margin is left.
Green Coffee Company does the opposite. It grows, mills, ships and sells its own coffee, so it captures far more of the value along the way.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/be20dace-e0e4-41c5-a98e-27cdaf9e697c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_P.S. Every morning, millions of Americans buy coffee. Almost none of them own a piece of where it comes from. While this company is still private,**[you can.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/b64f7870-32e4-4577-995b-9eb0b76616e0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_
#### The New Toll Booth
## **Washington rebuilds its tariff wall, and the bill lands on next year 's price tags**
_The Supreme Court knocked the old tariffs down in February. This week 's plan puts most of them back._
Our partner above sells coffee that crosses a border before it reaches the shelf, and this week Washington changed the price of crossing for a large share of what America buys from abroad.
The Trade Representative's office on Wednesday proposed [a new round of tariffs](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/e3fd5288-8ad3-4d17-b9b3-de0b1e783afc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on 14 economies, including China, the European Union, Japan and South Korea. It followed an eight-month probe into what officials call structural excess capacity, meaning factories that turn out far more than their home markets can use.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/23948b49-1e5c-48fb-aab2-af0ab55f12c2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
China faces 20 percent, which could double to 40 percent. Vietnam faces up to 35 percent, and Japan and the EU up to 15 percent. The duties are likely to take effect early next year, after a comment period and a hearing, and where a country already pays the forced-labor tariffs imposed in July, it will owe [the higher of the two rates](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/49579e94-5153-427c-9391-6d73135cd78a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
This reaches the price tags on electronics, machinery and appliances, much of which comes from the economies on the list. One economist expects the duties to push prices higher and keep the cost of goods firm into next year.
I have watched enough of these rounds to know the first list is rarely the last one; the deals tend to arrive after the threats.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/7697a197-d85a-450e-ac24-b2dc97191f25?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/a2cd6a07-cbed-4603-8dcf-f91114db3c75?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Our next partner is focused on Elon Musk's next invention; his latest one is already giving rides in Texas.
#### From Our Partners
## **[New Patent Reveals Elon Musk's Next Breakthrough: M.A.G.I.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/79cc2cf4-a316-4023-bad7-b4d0f81762a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
**Editor 's Note:** Jeff Brown and Marc Chaikin, two investment legends who picked Nvidia 10 years ago, are predicting that by the end of this month, Elon Musk's new AI breakthrough will collide with a strange market pattern with a flawless 100% track record of massive market gains.[ ](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/79cc2cf4-a316-4023-bad7-b4d0f81762a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[Click here to see the details](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/79cc2cf4-a316-4023-bad7-b4d0f81762a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)[ ](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/c5160a1c-d78e-4b52-b8f8-97c0f1ee850c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**or read more below because the last time this happened everyday folks had a chance to turn $10,000 into as much as $350,000 in just about 12 months.
Dear Reader,
Take a look at Elon Musk's new patent below...
Because it protects a new invention that could rewrite the future of wealth forever.
I'm talking about a radical new form of AI I call "M.A.G.I."
One so revolutionary that Elon called it an "infinite money glitch."
**[Click here to see the details](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/79cc2cf4-a316-4023-bad7-b4d0f81762a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** because he believes this is a once-in-a-generation opportunity to create wealth on a scale most people can't even comprehend.
What's the upside potential here?
I know this is going to sound crazy...
But Elon is projecting growth of over 7,000,000%.
Let that sink in.
That's enough to turn $100 into more than $7 million.
This sounds absolutely insane.
But then again... everything Elon has ever done sounded insane at first.
Self-driving cars.
Reusable rockets that land themselves.
Brain chips that let paralyzed people control computers with their minds.
Crazy ideas.
But he turned them into trillion-dollar realities.
So here's the real question...
Will you watch Elon build another empire from the sidelines...
Or will you finally position yourself to potentially become one of the winners in his next trillion-dollar revolution?
**[Click here to get the details](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/79cc2cf4-a316-4023-bad7-b4d0f81762a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/79cc2cf4-a316-4023-bad7-b4d0f81762a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)because I believe Elon will flip the switch on this new invention by the end of this month.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/79cc2cf4-a316-4023-bad7-b4d0f81762a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
#### No Hands on the Wheel
### **Tesla 's driverless Cybercab comes with a $29,990 sticker and a monthly bill**
Tesla began public Cybercab rides in Dallas last week, and on Wednesday it widened its service area there by roughly 83 percent. The two-seat car has no steering wheel or pedals, and a small group of invited buyers can now own one. As of mid-November, Tesla had 1,306 registered robotaxis in Texas, against 1,321 for Alphabet's Waymo.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/a1ba0794-d73e-4b3c-85d8-8b41b5cd45d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* The Cybercab costs $29,990 before taxes, with deliveries to invited buyers expected in December, according to [the terms Tesla laid out](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/9467ae90-1ffc-45f6-bbbd-ba37993b9e8f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* It will not drive without a $299-a-month Autonomy Subscription, which puts the first year near $3,600 before insurance or upkeep; Musk has said the fee should be closer to $115.
* Owners can use it only inside Tesla's Texas robotaxi zones: Austin, Houston, Dallas, Fort Worth and San Antonio.
* Federal safety regulators are [investigating how Tesla certified](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/3d574b81-52b9-4c36-9db1-7ae005ff1eeb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a car with no manual controls.

For now, the monthly fee is the line worth reading twice, because it outlasts the sticker price.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/e0cf6069-0d57-45ad-be16-ca3ee3607c5d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
#### One Number
**5.51%** is what a new Series I savings bond pays for its first six months if bought between now and April, according to [the Treasury's latest reset](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/48db07c4-e067-48af-bd01-089d3bd916b5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Of that, 1.40 points is a fixed rate that stays with the bond for its 30-year life, the highest since 2006, and the rest moves with inflation every six months. Purchases are capped at $10,000 a person a year, the money is tied up for 12 months, and cashing out before five years costs the last three months of interest.
#### Why I Led Here
Tariffs are a tax that shows up at the register long after the headline fades, which is why I put them on top on the biggest shopping day of the year.
What I am watching next is Jan. 10, when the trade truce with China runs out, and the formal notice that will list exact rates. Until those land, the only change I am making is buying what we genuinely need from overseas this winter and leaving the nice-to-haves for spring.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/115a3e3a-dba0-414e-8248-d628104ea971?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/15649e96-8d1b-4bd3-957a-1d7499f68406?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_When the world moves, hold your ground._

Friend, Today is Native Heritage Day. Native folks have been stewarding this land for many thousands of years before it was ever called the United States. As you know, the history of Thanksgiving has been whitewashed to deny the violent horrors that U.S. settlers and the U.S government have committed against Indigenous people. These horrors are still ongoing. For example, in my state, the University of Michigan is trying to build a data center on top of historic Indigenous sites that could include burial grounds. I’m pushing back. And the U.S. Senate just passed the permitting reform bill known as BAAJA (the misnamed _Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act_), which was written by the fossil fuel industry to take away our rights — including Tribes’ sovereign rights to make decisions about their lands and ancestral homelands. BAAJA could fast-track polluting projects like data centers and toxic mines on sacred Native sites and ancestral Native lands, undoing requirements for Tribal consultation.**** **For months I’ve been working with Native activists and Tribal Nations in opposition to this give-away to Big Oil and Big Tech.** I’ll keep up this fight as BAAJA moves to the House of Representatives next week. As part of the federal government, members of Congress have legal responsibilities to uphold Tribal sovereignty and to respect Tribes’ treaty rights — which include the right to adequate healthcare and nutrition, in exchange for the U.S. government coercively stealing their lands. [**Please add your name today to demand Congress fulfill its legal responsibilities to Tribal Nations by rejecting BAAJA and other attacks on sovereignty, reversing Trump’s cuts to health and nutrition programs (which violate Tribal treaty rights)****_and_****expanding access to food and healthcare, and passing policies to protect ancestral Indigenous homelands such as my**** _No AI Data Centers on Federal Lands Ac_**** _t_.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39Vp4gkIh90ovDrixVFaBLcIprMiHFe9itquzupTk4XLtKzInOR8zNJZnEY9Bk_oCzwnfyCNqYYzos5cHfcbKCtbiA8XPFysDBAr-KEJCK3akcLaRwEOBOrkxljJ9DsF-zwREvi_lfu2zmSmD1IyaJ-eMQg7N6WQfGvc4ZxjF96NXLFpKdUWqkub-A6R4O6AGaKnMLZjuzgROY_RrNPUhxlo80ezf85m1ge328BmfUBrKJd6MWz5co9GNzTnyeQ5JDBe8N48rJaYbY0FjVAfKAw0kw1ee8yrN61OagJhq4syAFMv2KJDow5r1uTbHR6XE90F1-ldRpVOI73cge4Y0o61PbzgJYj2JubU0H93T50XzxsitKX-UCty0ETZ4T2g8BRksomBW3tHBYczxHFXTg09lRAYlNyX4s2p_Oqt3ElgMB6k-WIuD4qvLzm94t_wHIoIlB1DjRcS18Zfo65zs523ltwtTVEddnOAfVpxE7wiIrgrOU3JmKY7anz0nOwzms/4w3/j66fhndZTA2sXb1HqXd86w/h1/h001.gABMmkU55xFB2YJTlMpjHQAVS___0ImbSSBPacYZurs) [ **SIGN ON FOR NATIVE RIGHTS**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39Vp4gkIh90ovDrixVFaBLcIprMiHFe9itquzupTk4XLtKzInOR8zNJZnEY9Bk_oCzwnfyCNqYYzos5cHfcbKCtbiA8XPFysDBAr-KEJCK3akcLaRwEOBOrkxljJ9DsF-zwREvi_lfu2zmSmD1IyaJ-eMQg7N6WQfGvc4ZxjF96NXLFpKdUWqkub-A6R4O6AGZOoFCYpopEj1PoQvULub9b0kIO-lo7oTaU55Pa5qRbIMC99UrlaXFoONdD5C_c8b9Xwy57cAmTN-r9hM-9e5zCnC8v0g_lN67gu3Ow1sU4Pj8Fis43vg3EwEMYzc-JjDEQaevjOeyb4WSUPFS1vthnqMWOxBbiY2Ww5cKK350Wc_XUJ9ThvQoAhjRI2AOFspwQXA-OreC0Oo2KDZgCMc4vjqM-2zhC1ZBGoxZ6e-ZczCq35ktlzM0Zjy0GjX-c47v2V462hCnLqAj_KgeY7taQU83K1h-ap6_7zGYW3_19kYh8TVkbfCxR0P_FaKhxlbg/4w3/j66fhndZTA2sXb1HqXd86w/h2/h001.yV_l6h81XGfujyxqed1ExeQHGvClfkTlMQ6PbDCu18k) Thank you for taking action. clean_body: | | | Friend, Today is Native Heritage Day. Native folks have been stewarding this land for many thousands of years before it was ever called the United States. As you know, the history of Thanksgiving has been whitewashed to deny the violent horrors that U.S. settlers and the U.S government have committed against Indigenous people. These horrors are still ongoing. For example, in my state, the University of Michigan is trying to build a data center on top of historic Indigenous sites that could include burial grounds. I’m pushing back. And the U.S. Senate just passed the permitting reform bill known as BAAJA (the misnamed Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act), which was written by the fossil fuel industry to take away our rights — including Tribes’ sovereign rights to make decisions about their lands and ancestral homelands. BAAJA could fast-track polluting projects like data centers and toxic mines on sacred Native sites and ancestral Native lands, undoing requirements for Tribal consultation.** For months I’ve been working with Native activists and Tribal Nations in opposition to this give-away to Big Oil and Big Tech. I’ll keep up this fight as BAAJA moves to the House of Representatives next week. As part of the federal government, members of Congress have legal responsibilities to uphold Tribal sovereignty and to respect Tribes’ treaty rights — which include the right to adequate healthcare and nutrition, in exchange for the U.S. government coercively stealing their lands. Thank you for taking action. I promise to continue pushing to uphold the federal government’s responsibilities to Tribes and Native people. As the co-founder and co-chair of the U.S. House of Representatives’ Environmental Justice Caucus, I’ll be supporting policies next year such as the Environmental Justice For All Act , which was developed in coordination with Tribal Nations and Native activists. I’ll keep you posted! Together, let’s keep fighting alongside Indigenous leaders to protect our rights, our planet, and the living beings who call Earth home. body:

# Jeff Bezos already owns a newspaper
### You read a newsroom no billionaire owns. Here's how to help keep it that way.
| | | [Drop Site News](https://substack.com/@dropsitenews)
---
| Nov 27
---
| [](https://substack.com/@dropsitenews)
---
You've been reading Drop Site for free, and that's exactly how we built it. Every story we publish is free to read, with no paywalls ever, because we believe reporting this important shouldn't be locked away.
But here's the part most readers don't see: about 20,000 people pay for Drop Site, out of more than 850,000 who read it. That small group funds everything, from the reporters in war zones to the lawyers who defend our stories in court.
Today we're asking you to join them. For Black Friday, we're offering **[30% off a full year of Drop Site. That's less than 20 cents a day, under $1.50 a week.](https://substack.com/redirect/6a64bb60-1c51-4643-9a59-23808a50f06b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Jeff Bezos will do just fine this Black Friday, and he already owns a newspaper. Here's a chance to back a newsroom no billionaire owns.
[Back Drop Site, not Bezos - 30% off!](https://substack.com/redirect/6a64bb60-1c51-4643-9a59-23808a50f06b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
_Offer ends Monday, Nov. 30, at midnight ET._
**What your support makes possible**
Since we launched, Drop Site has broken stories most of the press wouldn't touch, and the reporting has had real consequences:
* **The Minab school massacre:** On the first day of the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran, missiles struck a school in Minab, killing at least 156 people, 120 of them children. While Washington deflected blame, Drop Site obtained photos of the missile fragments, which experts identified as U.S. Tomahawks made by Raytheon. We also obtained documents showing the building had been registered as a civilian school for a decade. That put evidence on the record that the administration couldn't explain away.
* **Accountability at home:** We tracked AIPAC's dark money so relentlessly through the midterms that Semafor noted a big AIPAC-linked donation "now comes with the cost of Drop Site covering it." Our Epstein investigations exposed his role brokering security deals and intelligence backchannels for Israel, and we helped build a searchable public archive of Epstein emails for journalists, researchers and lawmakers.
* **Gaza:** We're the only American outlet publishing consistent on-the-ground reporting from Gaza, and the only Western outlet with access to Hamas and Palestinian Islamic Jihad leadership. Our investigation into an Israeli combat battalion filming itself demolishing Palestinian homes put that evidence in front of human rights organizations and legal authorities, so it can't be buried.
* **Iran, Yemen and U.S. foreign policy:** Our exclusive reporting on backchannel talks between the Trump administration and Iranian officials broke through White House denials and shaped the global news cycle. When Trump announced a halt to the U.S. bombing of Yemen, he cited a Houthi offer that Drop Site reported first.

Every one of these stories cost real money: reporters in war zones, translators, editors, lawyers. Corporate outlets have far more money for this kind of work. They didn't do it. We did, because readers chose to pay for journalism they could get for free.
[Will you join them for less than $1.50 a week?](https://substack.com/redirect/6a64bb60-1c51-4643-9a59-23808a50f06b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Keep this reporting going: 30% off ->](https://substack.com/redirect/6a64bb60-1c51-4643-9a59-23808a50f06b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**Nobody kills a story at Drop Site**
When one of our journalists was sued in the UK over reporting on the BBC, readers raised more than $330,000 for the defense, and we've already won a major procedural victory. When Senate candidate Mike Rogers gave us five days to retract our investigation into him, readers put up $50,000 almost overnight. We didn't retract a word.
That's what it means to have no corporate owner and no billionaire to answer to. Nobody can call in a favor to make a story disappear. We answer to our readers, and to no one else.
**Why we 're asking you**
Drop Site will always be free to read. But free to read isn't free to make. If you've read our reporting, shared it, or argued about it with someone at the Thanksgiving table, you already know why it matters.
In 2027 we're launching a new Capitol Hill reporting operation and newsletter to cover the incoming Congress. We're putting more reporters on the ground and making a major push into video. We'll only go as far as our readers can take us, and right now, we need more of you with us.
**[So here's our ask: become a paid subscriber today.](https://substack.com/redirect/6a64bb60-1c51-4643-9a59-23808a50f06b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ A full year at 30% off, less than 20 cents a day, to keep this reporting free for everyone.](https://substack.com/redirect/6a64bb60-1c51-4643-9a59-23808a50f06b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Count me in: 30% OFF ->](https://substack.com/redirect/6a64bb60-1c51-4643-9a59-23808a50f06b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
_30% off ends Monday, Nov. 30, at midnight ET._
With real gratitude,
Ryan Grim & Jeremy Scahill
Co-founders, Drop Site News
P.S. [This Black Friday offer, ](https://substack.com/redirect/6a64bb60-1c51-4643-9a59-23808a50f06b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[30% off a full year](https://substack.com/redirect/6a64bb60-1c51-4643-9a59-23808a50f06b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[, ends Monday at midnight.](https://substack.com/redirect/6a64bb60-1c51-4643-9a59-23808a50f06b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) If now isn't the right time, we understand completely, and we're glad you're reading. Hey everyone. **What is the Democratic mandate?**
* * *
**First, please subscribe for just $5 a month to get every podcast, our daily news roundup, and exclusive articles.**
[ Upgrade to paid](https://substack..zu-Ckru9u-ZdIWw4ya12sz-0tYF2NPYToQeTc6wuF4w?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=226810863)
* * *
People have been talking about it because of the massive Democratic win across the board. It was such a shellacking of Republicans that, in my opinion, not many people saw the full scale of it coming. But the people who saw it coming understood why it was coming.
I don't believe this was a mandate for Democrats or everything in the Democratic platform. This was the swing of populist demands going from Democrat to Republican and back again, going back to the Obama era, without coming to fruition.
The American people are crying at the top of their lungs for things both parties keep promising to get done. We wait through two-, four-, and six-year cycles, depending on who is in office, and we keep screaming: **Get some of this shit done.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a4f1681e-5df6-4299-8b80-a681dde6199b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
We don't care if Republicans do it or Democrats do it. And those votes are following.
The dissatisfied people in the middle keep bringing up the same issues. They keep giving somebody else a chance. Democrats should not confuse winning an election with public approval of Democrats or everything Democrats want to do.
**This is not a progressive win or a DSA win. This is a populist win.**
If Democrats don't understand that, accomplish something, and act on it, they will lose very, very soon.
* * *
## The Economy Isn't Working for Average People
The economy keeps showing up across elections. People are saying it sucks. It isn't working for average people.
In Pew's fall 2026 survey, **84% of registered voters said the economy was very important to their vote**. That was the question being measured, rather than whether they thought the economy was bad. But the economy was at the top of the list. [www.pewresearch.org](https://substack.com/redirect/d84bfb87-2cd7-4402-ab8e-129d0543bb81?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
And people keep pointing at the stock market.
Look at the stock market. Look at the growth. Look at the gains.
Okay, but what about the people who aren't seeing those gains in their lives?
Gallup found that **62% of Americans owned stock in 2025** , including stocks held through retirement accounts. But among adults in households earning **less than $50,000, only 28% owned stock** , compared with **87% in households earning $100,000 or more** , based on its combined 2024-2025 surveys. [news.gallup.com](https://substack.com/redirect/a0437656-db66-4c01-9fad-894d74462150?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
So when you're pointing at the market, understand who you're talking to. Most people in that lower-income group aren't invested in it at all. And having some money in a retirement account doesn't mean your paycheck covers your life today.
Everybody gloats about growth. Meanwhile, people are looking at their wages and their bills and asking where their share went.
In my opinion, the economy is usually what makes people shift one way or the other. Does it work for the middle class? The normies? The average people?
If it doesn't, they're going to try somebody else.
* * *
## Healthcare Has Become a Populist Demand
Go back to the arguments about healthcare during the Obama years. Was it the government's responsibility? Stay out of my healthcare. Keep the government away from my doctor.
But rising costs, consolidation, massive hospital systems, high premiums, high copays, and inaccessibility have changed that conversation.
Doctors and nurses are stressed. Healthcare workers are stressed. The people trying to get care are stressed. People keep paying into a system that costs too much and makes getting help a fucking project.
Gallup's historical polling shows **44% in 2012** saying the federal government had a responsibility to ensure everyone had healthcare coverage. That reached **62% in 2024** and **64% in 2025**. [news.gallup.com](https://substack.com/redirect/f0ce4bd0-32cc-4151-b0fc-14a37562ba87?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I believe the costs and failures people experience have turned overhauling healthcare into a populist mandate. More people are looking at this and saying the government has a responsibility to fix it.
That is what our healthcare series is about. What does covering everybody actually look like? What system works here? How do we pay for it?
People are asking for healthcare they can afford and actually use. They've been asking. How many more campaigns are we going to have about it before they get it?
* * *
[](https://substack.com/redirect/5a0e673b-1b2c-4cbb-8c82-93ce81c48396?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)| | |
#### [What Does Healthcare for All Actually Mean? ](https://substack.com/redirect/5a0e673b-1b2c-4cbb-8c82-93ce81c48396?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

* * *
## How Are People Supposed to Live on These Wages?
Minimum wage is one of the clearest examples.
In **2013, 76% of Americans supported raising the federal minimum wage to $9 an hour**. In **2019, 67% supported raising it to $15 an hour**. Different amounts, different years, but substantial majorities asking for an increase. [news.gallup.com](https://substack.com/redirect/7a093fd5-eefd-45e4-a2bd-5a99ce2bcd95?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The federal minimum wage remains **$7.25 an hour** , where it has been since **July 2009**. [www.dol.gov](https://substack.com/redirect/df344705-2cff-4de8-beb9-60b3fda1e98a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Obama. Trump. Biden. Trump again.
States have raised their own minimum wages. Washington's floor is still sitting there.
More and more people are asking how somebody is supposed to live on these wages. And how many times have we heard somebody campaign on doing something about it?
People keep asking. Candidates keep promising. Another election comes around, and we're still having the conversation.
* * *
## People Want the Money Out of Politics
We want campaign finance reform. We want the money out.
Look at the billions going into campaigns. Look at the text messages, phone calls, billboards, and television ads. People are getting harassed all election season with **some of the most heinous shit they 've ever seen**, paid for by people and organizations they may never have heard of.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/65ed98c2-b4b1-48ee-868c-e160bfffe14b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)| | |
#### [How Low Will We Go: The Death of Political Decency in America](https://substack.com/redirect/65ed98c2-b4b1-48ee-868c-e160bfffe14b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
---
| | [The Angry Democrat](https://substack.com/profile/102996536-the-angry-democrat)| | *
---|---|---
| Oct 21
| [| Read full story
---](https://substack.com/redirect/65ed98c2-b4b1-48ee-868c-e160bfffe14b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
In **2018, 77% of Americans supported campaign-spending limits** , including **71% of Republicans and 85% of Democrats**. In **2023, 72% supported limits** , and **80% said large campaign donors had too much influence over decisions in Congress**. [www.pewresearch.org](https://substack.com/redirect/846b02f5-d4f8-4812-a8da-1a5728d8d637?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
This demand didn't disappear when the party in power changed.
Citizens United has completely perverted what I think our politics should be. I want it overturned. I want campaign finance reform.
**The amount of money is egregious. It 's gross.**
A normal person looks at all that money going into winning an election, watches those people get into office, and then gets told they can't actually do fuck all to improve their life.
There's money for another campaign. Money for another consultant. Money for another ad telling you why the other person is horrible.
But the things you've been asking for? Well, maybe next time.
I believe that frustration is reaching a fever pitch.
* * *
## Control Spending. Protect Social Security.
Spending and deficits are part of this, too.
In **2024, 54% of Americans said reducing the federal budget deficit should be a top priority**. That same year, **79% opposed reducing Social Security benefits** , including **77% of Republicans and 83% of Democrats**. [www.pewresearch.org](https://substack.com/redirect/427f4433-a591-4ed4-b9de-f1b2cd196e6d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
People want responsible spending. They also want the benefits they paid into.
Protecting Social Security is populist. I support raising the earnings cap for Social Security taxes so we can help fund the system instead of telling people their benefits need to be cut.
These are the conversations elected officials should be having. How do we protect what people paid for? How do we control the deficit? Where is the money going, and what are we getting for it?
People have been asking these questions across administrations. Changing the letter next to the president's name doesn't make them go away.
* * *
## End the Wars. End the Corruption.
Immigration reform. Border control. Ending forever wars and foreign wars. These are part of the populist frustration I'm talking about.
People keep getting promises about what government is going to do. Then they watch what actually happens.
And the corruption is right there with it.
The pardons. The backdoor dealings. The nepotism. The families getting privileges. People using the presidency and public office for their own benefit. The stock trading in Congress and the questions about who knew what before the market moved.
I want that stopped. Make it illegal. Investigate it. If somebody committed a crime, prosecute them. Put people in jail.
People shouldn't have to watch elected officials and the people around them get richer while being told there's no way to deliver what they campaigned on.
Ending corruption is populist. Making government work for the people paying for it is populist.
How many times do people have to say it?
* * *
## The Party Changes. The Demands Keep Coming.
This is what I think Democrats are at risk of missing.
The American people keep asking for an economy that works for them, affordable healthcare, wages they can live on, retirement security, less corruption, and a government that does what it promised.
The dissatisfaction keeps moving between parties. If Republicans won't do it, let's try Democrats. If Democrats won't do it, let's try Republicans.
That's the outcry I hear. That's the mandate I see.
Democrats won. I'm excited to see what they can do. But winning doesn't mean people approved every Democratic policy or signed up for the entire progressive agenda.
They gave Democrats another chance to get these things done.
If Democrats don't understand that, they're going to waste it. If these demands don't start getting enacted and having an effect on real people's lives, voters are going to look somewhere else again.
But I promise you, that patience isn't endless.
If people keep asking and neither party delivers, the next cry isn't going to be Democrat or Republican.
**It 'll be an uprising of the people.**
## **Stay Angry.**

| Is Your Microphone Snooping? Viral Warning Misleads ICE, Public
---
"If you have an iPhone and have installed a recent iOS update, you might not know that Apple turned ON the option for someone to remotely access your activity on your phone..."This viral message has circulated online for several weeks, accompanied by a set of instructions for disabling an iPhone feature called Live Listen. The meme and its instructions are misleading—the Live Listen feature poses no risk to your privacy. Leaving it on will not expose your iPhone to remote access. Turning it off will not protect your privacy. Here's what Live Listen actually does: with the setting enabled, you can use your AirPods or hearing aids to listen to the microphone on your own iPhone. If you're in a noisy bar and need to hear what someone on the other end of the table is saying, you can put in your AirPods, turn on Live Listen, and then put your phone near the person speaking and listen through the phone's microphone. The meme mentions a Remote Control toggle, which sounds scary, but this one merely lets you disable an ongoing Live Listen session with your Apple Watch or an iPad signed in to your same Apple ID. It doesn't let you start sessions except from your own iPhone, and it doesn't offer remote access to your device or information. You can [read more about it from Apple](https://click.iphonelife.com/ga/click/2-17209631-109-17275-262632-8943751-ea025f0372-bh289938cf). The feature is harmless, but the viral warning has legs. [According to The Intercept](https://click.iphonelife.com/ga/click/2-17209631-109-17275-262632-8943752-d42f00bc3a-bh289938cf), it's been repeated by multiple law enforcement officers and agencies, including the "chief intelligence officer" of Chicago's Homeland Security Investigations (HSI), a division of Immigration and Customs Enforcement.**The Bottom Line:** This claim is easy to check by looking at Apple's [documentation for their own features](https://click.iphonelife.com/ga/click/2-17209631-109-17275-262632-8943751-ea025f0372-bh289938cf), though the toggle for Remote Control could maybe do with a less ominous name. Even if you are not a chief intelligence officer for a government agency, you should still fact-check security advice you find on social media before sharing it. If you encounter social media security or privacy advice and you'd like us to look at it, feel free to send a reply to this newsletter.

## More Evidence AI Chatbots Are Not Private (Even When They Say They Are)
HD Moore, the chief research officer at security firm Dragos, launched an investigation into how often passwords entered in a chat with an AI service were leaked to hackers. He created thousands of unique chats with AI exchange services—these are the services that you can use to help you find the cheapest or the most appropriate AI model to use for each chat, rather than going straight to Claude or ChatGPT—and each of these thousands of chats included just one unique security credential that had never been used. Then he sat back and saw which of those credentials got used. It didn't take long. In some cases, hackers had compromised the exchange service; in others, the services themselves were selling chats including the secrets to hackers. [Ars Technica has a good explanation](https://click.iphonelife.com/ga/click/2-17209631-109-17275-262632-8943754-d3883f61ff-bh289938cf) of this, but the original blog post comes from [Dragos](https://click.iphonelife.com/ga/click/2-17209631-109-17275-262632-8943755-ec9e5d8bc3-bh289938cf).**The Bottom Line:** If you are going to use an AI, do not share secrets, especially passwords. Your chats with AI agents are not private. They may be accessed by the AI company. Exchange services, which offer to route your prompts to the cheapest AI service or the appropriate agent, are unregulated, and currently that ecosystem is fraught with leaks, fraud, and abuse.
