## Signal Messenger Plans to Block Screenshots to Beat AI Agent Snooping
We have often recommended Signal as the most secure private messaging service for consumers. It's free, it's not-for-profit, and its encryption and privacy practices are exemplary. Now, the privacy promise of Signal is under threat from AI agents integrated into operating systems, such as Siri's new onscreen awareness feature. Onscreen awareness scans what's on your screen to learn about you. While Siri has many privacy protections built in, it is still a secondary service that is able to see what's on your screen, including Signal chats. Signal doesn't like this, because it undermines the service's promise of security. Signal has announced it plans to block all screenshots of the Signal app on iOS to prevent the AI from reading them. You can read [the Signal blog](https://click.iphonelife.com/ga/click/2-17209631-109-17275-262632-8943757-fa65a05a55-bh289938cf) if you're interested in the full rationale and more details. **The Bottom Line:** As of this writing, the Signal update is not out yet. Once it releases, you'll be able to turn screenshots back on by visiting the Signal app, opening Settings, and poking around until you find the Block Siri AI toggle. There are legitimate reasons to screenshot messages, of course, especially when you need a permanent record of what someone has said to you.
## Security Breach at USDA Takes Services Offline
A security incident at the US Department of Agriculture has taken multiple services offline. It is still unclear what, if anything, was compromised and who will be affected beyond those who cannot access the affected systems, such as the farmer payment tool. Read more at [ABC News](https://click.iphonelife.com/ga/click/2-17209631-109-17275-262632-8943758-57715de707-bh289938cf).**The Bottom Line:** If you need to access USDA web services, you might have to wait a few days.

## FBI Breach Affected National Crime Information Center
A security breach at the FBI has affected the National Crime Information Center (NCIC), a database that allows law enforcement to share information about background checks and warrants. It is not known yet how serious the incident is or what was affected. The FBI has declined to comment. Read more at [AP News](https://click.iphonelife.com/ga/click/2-17209631-109-17275-262632-8943759-1cbd7826db-bh289938cf).**The Bottom Line:** If substantiated, this would be the second serious breach of FBI systems in just a few months, following closely on the heels of the [September hack of the FBI jobs portal by the ShinyHunters](https://click.iphonelife.com/ga/click/2-17209631-109-17275-262632-8943760-24c8135e93-bh289938cf) gang.
## SpaceX Sued Over CSAM
Grok AI is a chatbot developed by SpaceXSI to compete with ChatGPT. Unlike most of its competitors, it features a "spicy mode" that can be prompted to generate adult content, including images. This feature can be abused to generate child sexual abuse material (CSAM) and non-consensual intimate imagery (NCII). In response to complaints, SpaceXSI did not eliminate the ability to generate the illegal material; they added a paywall so they could profit off it. This week Virginia and Oregon have become the first US states to sue over the matter. Read the full story at [Ars Technica](https://click.iphonelife.com/ga/click/2-17209631-109-17275-262632-8943761-fd90e40d2e-bh289938cf).**The Bottom Line:** There is no reasonable precaution you could take that would prevent people from using Grok AI to transform normal and fully clothed images into non-consensual intimate imagery. You could refuse to post any images of yourself or your grandkids on social media, and delete every existing image, but you shouldn't have to. Don't use Grok AI, and especially do not pay for Grok AI. Competitor products don't have this problem.

Open-source intelligence is the material collated from social media, news, phone books, advertising profiles, and other free and available sources. Intelligence agencies and hackers collect open-source intelligence in order to profile people of interest. We don't know yet who accessed this system or what they intend to do with it.**The Bottom Line:** Many of our privacy and security recommendations focus on reducing how much can be learned about you from open-source intelligence, but there is a big difference between steps that will protect you from criminal scammers profiling you and the kinds of steps necessary to stop a state-funded security apparatus like the CIA. But if hackers gained access to the profiling built by the CIA or NSA, that would be a different matter.

name: OnePA Team
subject: The Black Friday deal working families never get
body:
Pennsylvania’s minimum wage has been stuck at $7.25 since 2009, and a state law bans Philadelphia, Pittsburgh, and every other city from raising it. Tell lawmakers to repeal it. | |
---
Peter, Today shoppers across the country will line up for Black Friday deals, and the cashiers, stockers, and warehouse workers behind those sales will be on their feet through one of the busiest days of the year. In Pennsylvania, a big corporation can legally pay workers $7.25 an hour, the same minimum wage our state has had since July 2009. **Our cities are ready to do better, but state law ties their hands. Since 2006, Pennsylvania has banned local governments from raising their minimum wage above the state’s.** A full-time worker earning $7.25 makes about $15,080 a year, while a worker a short drive away in New Jersey earns at least $15.92 an hour. This rule is called minimum wage preemption, and it was passed by a Republican-majority legislature and signed by Gov. Ed Rendell. **Half of all states have a law like it, and these laws are pushed through by corporate interests and right-wing groups like the American Legislative Exchange Council (ALEC).** Big employers profit from keeping wages low, and working families pay the price at the checkout counter and on the first of the month when rent is due. **State legislators wrote these bans, and state legislators can repeal them. # [Dow jumps 510 points for strongest week since 2025](https://substack.com/redirect/264c553a-3780-4e41-bdc7-fd2c633ac51c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Stocks **[climbed Friday to finish a volatile shortened week,](https://substack.com/redirect/724183d0-da32-4f89-a6bd-4ac4bf19275b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with the Dow up 510 points and the major averages on pace for their best weekly gains since April 2025.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/264c553a-3780-4e41-bdc7-fd2c633ac51c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Huang return catalyst:** Jensen Huang's Monday reinstatement as Nvidia CEO sent the stock up 31% and drove the S&P 500 and Nasdaq to their strongest single-day gains since April 2025.
* **Tech sector rebound:** Meta and Amazon each gained about 3%, Broadcom rose 2%, and Anthropic added more than 8% as technology led the Friday bounce.
* **Weekly gains solid:** Entering the session the Dow was up 5%, the S&P nearly 5%, and the Nasdaq more than 5%, putting the Dow on track for its biggest weekly advance since April 2025.
* **Broader context:** The market was closed Thursday for Thanksgiving and closes early Friday; earlier AI-related pressure and rate-hike expectations had weighed on sentiment before the recovery.

# [Huang's rapid return reignites Nvidia key-man risk debate](https://substack.com/redirect/264c553a-3780-4e41-bdc7-fd2c633ac51c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Nvidia reinstated co-founder Jensen Huang as CEO less than two weeks after his resignation over personal matters, reigniting questions about whether **[major tech leaders are viewed as too big to fail.](https://substack.com/redirect/f714b50c-d75e-455c-834e-6a69837bdccb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/264c553a-3780-4e41-bdc7-fd2c633ac51c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Resignation and return:** Huang stepped down Nov. 12 after reports of extramarital affairs; the board indicated on the Nov. 17 earnings call it had no plan to reinstate him, then reversed course on Nov. 23.
* **Key-man concerns:** Analysts cited Huang's central role and the reported 60 direct reports he oversees as evidence of heavy reliance on a single leader for strategy and operations.
* **Expert views:** Dan Ives called Huang "not replaceable" and a linchpin of the AI Revolution; Gil Luria noted the market impact of his temporary departure from the world's most profitable company.
* **Succession questions:** Stephen Henriques argued nothing is too big to fail and pointed to successful transitions at Apple, Alphabet, Microsoft and Uber, while Patrick Moorhead said the board still owes investors a clear succession plan.

[Subscribe](https://substack.com/redirect/3af9e012-5dea-406e-be20-2d73c24bc9a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

# H[ackers breach Air Force flagship Cloud One platform](https://substack.com/redirect/264c553a-3780-4e41-bdc7-fd2c633ac51c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Hackers have **[breached the U.S. Air Force's flagship Cloud One computing platform,](https://substack.com/redirect/400acf6a-1204-43d9-b0b3-6930871e04d9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** discovered during a recent upgrade, raising risks to sensitive tactical, personnel and logistics data.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/264c553a-3780-4e41-bdc7-fd2c633ac51c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Discovery and disruption:** The intrusion was found within the past month while upgrading the system; it has disrupted operations, paused migrations of back-office applications, and blocked updates on existing apps.
* **Potential access:** One source said intruders exploited a software vulnerability to reach the control plane, likened to a "universal remote" that could in theory show aircraft status or spare-parts movement.
* **Systems affected:** Cloud One supports applications managing personnel data, pay, logistics, maintenance, air-defense radar feeds and the Theater Integrated Combat Munitions System across more than 200 locations.
* **Response:** Cyber Command was called in to assess damage; the Air Force said it does not comment on specific network security but continuously takes measures to protect systems.

# [Trump demands probe of 'fake' GDP after 4.3% revision](https://substack.com/redirect/264c553a-3780-4e41-bdc7-fd2c633ac51c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
President Trump called for an immediate investigation into the Bureau of Economic Analysis after third-quarter GDP growth was revised upward to 4.3**[% from the 3.4% advance estimate](https://substack.com/redirect/ad101fe9-bed1-495f-a62e-64216dbfdaf9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** released before the midterms.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/264c553a-3780-4e41-bdc7-fd2c633ac51c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Revision details:** The Commerce Department's BEA raised the annualized third-quarter figure by 0.9 percentage points on Wednesday; the advance estimate had been published Oct. 29, five days before the Nov. 3 elections.
* **Trump 's claim:** In a Truth Social post he described the pre-election numbers as "FAKE," a "RECORD SETTING ERROR," and a "massive, and purposeful, error," and asked why the higher figure was not issued earlier.
* **BEA explanation:** The agency said the upward revision mainly reflected more complete source data on investment and consumer spending; it routinely issues three estimates per quarter.
* **Next step:** The final third-quarter GDP estimate is scheduled for release on Dec. 23.

# [Musk pledges annual SpaceX share to every US kid as stock rises](https://substack.com/redirect/264c553a-3780-4e41-bdc7-fd2c633ac51c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
SpaceX shares climbed about 4% in premarket trading after Elon Musk said he will **[donate an additional company share to every American child each year,](https://substack.com/redirect/400acf6a-1204-43d9-b0b3-6930871e04d9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** expanding an earlier Trump Accounts gift.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/264c553a-3780-4e41-bdc7-fd2c633ac51c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **New annual pledge:** Musk posted on X that he will give "another share of SpaceX to all kids in America every year."
* **Prior Trump Accounts gift:** On Wednesday SpaceX said it would donate one Class A share to every active Trump Account, with Musk personally matching the gift; nearly 70 million accounts had been created as of October.
* **Transfer timing:** SpaceX's contribution is set for next month; Musk's personal shares will transfer after his lockup expires in June next year.
* **Trading reaction:** Shares jumped more than 7% in overnight Blue Ocean ATS trading after the post and were last about 4% higher in premarket amid a broader tech rebound.

[Subscribe](https://substack.com/redirect/3af9e012-5dea-406e-be20-2d73c24bc9a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
# [AI shopping agents hit Amazon blocks amid mixed Black Friday results](https://substack.com/redirect/264c553a-3780-4e41-bdc7-fd2c633ac51c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
AI shopping agents from OpenAI, Meta, Google and others are expanding, but **[Amazon and other sites are blocking or limiting them,](https://substack.com/redirect/e2171da4-7cd0-4125-aca0-dd2e5492d75b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** creating a patchy and often frustrating experience for users.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/264c553a-3780-4e41-bdc7-fd2c633ac51c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Retailer split:** Walmart and Sephora have opened sites to agents, while Amazon, eBay, United Airlines and Kohl's limit actions or block them; Coach and Gap allow browsing but not checkout.
* **Amazon 's stance:** The company has walled off its site most aggressively, previously blocking Meta's Muse and Elon Musk's Grok Bot from placing orders, and has sued Perplexity over its Comet agent.
* **Performance data:** A Visa study found agents failed about 43% of test shopping tasks, and in more than half of those failures they bought a product that did not meet the stated requirements.
* **Outlook:** McKinsey and ICSC have projected U.S. agentic-commerce revenue could reach up to $1 trillion by 2030, even as analysts note the current rollout remains messy.

[Subscribe](https://substack.com/redirect/3af9e012-5dea-406e-be20-2d73c24bc9a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
# [Black Friday set to challenge retail-bear outlooks](https://substack.com/redirect/264c553a-3780-4e41-bdc7-fd2c633ac51c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Despite inflation and consumer worries, recent retailer results suggest the holiday season[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/861ad86e-de6b-41d5-8cf9-3db96f69b588?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[could deliver stronger sales and stock performance](https://substack.com/redirect/861ad86e-de6b-41d5-8cf9-3db96f69b588?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** than many bears have expected.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/264c553a-3780-4e41-bdc7-fd2c633ac51c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Target momentum:** The discounter reported third-quarter sales up 7.1%, comparable sales up 5.6% and store traffic up 5%, then raised its full-year sales outlook to around 6%; shares are up 79% year-to-date near a 52-week high.
* **Other winners:** Walmart CFO John David Rainey said the holidays have started well, and Best Buy posted its best sales growth in years.
* **Consumer strength:** Household finances remain supported by income growth plus rising stock and home values, keeping spending power intact even with higher prices.
* **Broader takeaway:** Retailers are entering the season with real momentum rather than the sharp slowdown some forecasts had projected.

* * *

# [Ford unveils GT41 Hypercar for 2027 Le Mans return](https://substack.com/redirect/264c553a-3780-4e41-bdc7-fd2c633ac51c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Ford[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/9e115572-b5f8-47f0-994b-4a62489bb944?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[revealed its new GT41 Hypercar](https://substack.com/redirect/9e115572-b5f8-47f0-994b-4a62489bb944?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** during the Thanksgiving Day game at Ford Field, pairing a 5.4-liter V8 with a hybrid system as it prepares an all-Ford effort to win Le Mans outright in June 2027.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/264c553a-3780-4e41-bdc7-fd2c633ac51c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Powertrain:** The car uses a naturally aspirated, in-house-designed 5.4-liter Coyote-based V8 paired with a hybrid system drawing on Ford's production hybrid and battery expertise.
* **Le Mans goal:** CEO Jim Farley said the team is returning next summer "to take on Ferrari and the best of the world to win Le Mans outright" in a fully internal Ford Racing program.
* **Heritage link:** The GT41 builds on the GT40, which won the 24 Hours of Le Mans four consecutive years starting in 1966, the story chronicled in the film Ford v Ferrari.
* **Broader benefits:** Farley noted that lessons in battery technology, hybrid-control software and predictive-failure AI from the program can transfer to vehicles such as the Transit and Super Duty.

#
Hi there,
Know someone who has made Blexas their entire personality?

body:
Black women are the backbone of the Democratic Party.
| | | [](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001PNtByXvK5TPQZo0g-pvnOzcZWB8btnv-7ff6SIqkuWuHnEnyaB77fcJU-uCIAyxeBgXXPPubkCrXZRiXC5UTBG5eaMSQxOqhzslYq22XbJtZq4b56SN80UpmrdrarkKh4cO9DlDZ_hZpgeHdmwRTtPVyXLW8thDrfJk-vN-xsf6_MWUkQk7oBJk4W2mRwknXy9e_Gcn3PUF9c0ISzfFhp22nGKMD6wO2as5XW8ARxvk=&c=PTFNi_nacfU7yA0iTLiNFxiAnA0yv0zwBBstxvABtx62Sm-m1wi51Q==&ch=Pj3MofgYr7xWOQSnZB4K0i_jXRm8ZTMMltM-ezvioyC6y8uRfEMD7w==)

Let’s be abundantly clear:
**Black women are the backbone of the Democratic Party.**
On Election Day, 93% of Black women voted for Democrats. They knocked the doors. They organized their churches, their families, and their neighborhoods. They turned out across the Deep South in numbers that stunned the experts, and they delivered the blue wave that just won us the House and the Senate.
Every time our backs were against the wall, Black women showed up.
And far too often, the party thanked them with a speech and then moved on.
Not this time.
On December 12, we have a chance to do more than say thank you. We have a chance to make history:
[](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001PNtByXvK5TPQZo0g-pvnOzcZWB8btnv-7ff6SIqkuWuHnEnyaB77fcJU-uCIAyxeKmEjUO8Ww45m9EsdKdjsgS-d3CvtQvHmlzz7Z-k5-eKSJUNAmiTEs-aFFXsdlolaIt9pVprSBQGVpzjWEvJbFgmkaGf_qd25PHfJO4vK4JYO1WFvVfQ4ztbM1_iEQYwkNOyE8ZSbUYf5qs6_sVpacQZVfA3w33tDlHuZ9pkPFgR2n4ZPhh_u3zlXy5WwSvkS&c=PTFNi_nacfU7yA0iTLiNFxiAnA0yv0zwBBstxvABtx62Sm-m1wi51Q==&ch=Pj3MofgYr7xWOQSnZB4K0i_jXRm8ZTMMltM-ezvioyC6y8uRfEMD7w==)
---
Rep. Patricia “Pat” Moore (D) is headed to a runoff. **_If she wins, she’ll be the first Black woman Louisiana has EVER sent to Congress._**
Pat has spent 19 years serving her community in Monroe, first on the Ouachita Parish Police Jury and now in the state House. She’s exactly the kind of leader Black women have built this party around for generations, and exactly the kind of leader they deserve to see in Washington.
But MAGA won’t hand this seat over. Republicans have held it since 2004, and they’ll fight with everything they have to keep it.
Black women have shown up for Democrats every single time. Now it’s our turn to show up for them.
[**Please, can you rush a donation of even just $3 to help elect Pat Moore and make Louisiana history on December 12?**](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001PNtByXvK5TPQZo0g-pvnOzcZWB8btnv-7ff6SIqkuWuHnEnyaB77fcJU-uCIAyxeKmEjUO8Ww45m9EsdKdjsgS-d3CvtQvHmlzz7Z-k5-eKSJUNAmiTEs-aFFXsdlolaIt9pVprSBQGVpzjWEvJbFgmkaGf_qd25PHfJO4vK4JYO1WFvVfQ4ztbM1_iEQYwkNOyE8ZSbUYf5qs6_sVpacQZVfA3w33tDlHuZ9pkPFgQg3ShqW4CQH1ru1xZBMa1r&c=PTFNi_nacfU7yA0iTLiNFxiAnA0yv0zwBBstxvABtx62Sm-m1wi51Q==&ch=Pj3MofgYr7xWOQSnZB4K0i_jXRm8ZTMMltM-ezvioyC6y8uRfEMD7w==)

To: <dpwillis67@gmail.com>
Derek, Adam Schiff here. I want to bring you up to date on the latest threat I received from the Trump Justice Department — the second time in two years Trump’s DOJ has come after me.
Last week, I received a threat on Justice Department letterhead from Aaron Reitz, the U.S. Attorney for the Southern District of Texas.
**Today, I’m responding.**
**[Before I tell you more, will you chip in $10 to show you have my back and support my work in the Senate?](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/8046?t=13&amount=10&refcode=aschiff_email_112726_dojresponsebump&akid=10960%2E5257348%2Eclhlgi)**

Aaron Reitz threatened me with “legal consequences” if I don’t stop investigating and doing oversight of President Trump and the corruption in his administration.
_So why exactly is he threatening me?_
Because I’ve called for oversight and transparency.
Of the massive contributions to Trump’s ballroom, to find out who’s really behind them and whether there’s some kind of crooked bargain at play.
Of Freedom 250, the organization set up to raise money for the Fourth of July celebration.
Of media payments to Donald Trump after he sued ABC and CBS.
Of law firms that have done work for the president after capitulating to his threats.
Essentially, Reitz has made it clear that DOJ will investigate anyone investigating the president.
Here’s the thing, Derek: I’ve read the Constitution.
I know Congress has both the right and the duty to do oversight. And it is crazy to threaten senators for doing their jobs.
**So today, I'm sending a letter to Aaron Reitz telling him that I won’t stop doing my job.**
I’m calling on him to withdraw this absurd request. We’re going to continue doing the oversight that the American people voted for in overwhelming numbers.

body:
The lessons we can learn from this election.
| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/144155227/662586732/-3547583?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImViZWEyMTMxLTk2ZWEtZjExMS05MWYzLTAwMGQzYTUzMzE5YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=qmdt8QS_vvx_XTRFz9cC1cE2aAv4R2IOmsPIgSMKH8M=&emci=372b2599-28e5-f111-91f3-000d3a533978&emdi=ebea2131-96ea-f111-91f3-000d3a53319b&ceid=8431045)
---

Peter, before this election is too far in the rearview, I want to take a minute to acknowledge something. Democracy was on the line in this election — and you showed decisively that we’re not willing to let it go to ruin. When President Trump started an unprecedented redistricting crisis, we knew the path ahead would be tough. We acknowledged that democracy is a muscle: to make it strong, we have to exercise it. So we put our heads down and did the work. But even as maps were redrawn everywhere from Texas to Alabama to Florida, it was hard to imagine the historic wins we’d be celebrating today. Because of you, we've taken on fight after fight to defeat Republican gerrymandering, voter suppression, and obstruction. The individual victories are too many to name in one email. On the whole, they were decisive. In this election, the American people spoke in a clear voice that they’re not going to let politicians cheat their way into power. In spite of all those rigged maps, we’ll start next year with Democrats in charge of both chambers of Congress. We’ll see at least 10 state legislative chambers flip from red to blue. We’ll have six new Democratic trifectas. All of this together delivers a powerful statement that we can go up against Donald Trump and his team of anti-democracy radicals — and win. It requires uncompromising resistance and unprecedented mobilization. But we will not cower in the face of threats to representative democracy. Our work is far from over. Republicans are plotting right now to redraw maps before the next cycle — and we could see a state or two start any day now during the lame-duck period. We will fight them (again). We will defeat them (again). Bank on it. Our north star is clearer than ever: Save our democracy today, so we can heal it tomorrow. Peter: You helped make this once-in-a-generation election night possible. Remember how it feels right now. Remember how hard-fought this victory was. Because when we are tested again — and we will be tested again — we’ll need to call on these lessons. We’ll need to summon every ounce of strength and determination to fight. I’m so proud to be part of this movement with you. In solidarity, Eric H. Holder, Jr.

clean_body: The lessons we can learn from this election. | Peter, before this election is too far in the rearview, I want to take a minute to acknowledge something. Democracy was on the line in this election — and you showed decisively that we’re not willing to let it go to ruin. When President Trump started an unprecedented redistricting crisis, we knew the path ahead would be tough. We acknowledged that democracy is a muscle: to make it strong, we have to exercise it. So we put our heads down and did the work. But even as maps were redrawn everywhere from Texas to Alabama to Florida, it was hard to imagine the historic wins we’d be celebrating today. Because of you, we've taken on fight after fight to defeat Republican gerrymandering, voter suppression, and obstruction. The individual victories are too many to name in one email. On the whole, they were decisive. In this election, the American people spoke in a clear voice that they’re not going to let politicians cheat their way into power. In spite of all those rigged maps, we’ll start next year with Democrats in charge of both chambers of Congress. We’ll see at least 10 state legislative chambers flip from red to blue. We’ll have six new Democratic trifectas. All of this together delivers a powerful statement that we can go up against Donald Trump and his team of anti-democracy radicals — and win. It requires uncompromising resistance and unprecedented mobilization. But we will not cower in the face of threats to representative democracy. Our work is far from over. Republicans are plotting right now to redraw maps before the next cycle — and we could see a state or two start any day now during the lame-duck period. We will fight them (again). We will defeat them (again). Bank on it. Our north star is clearer than ever: Save our democracy today, so we can heal it tomorrow. Peter: You helped make this once-in-a-generation election night possible. Remember how it feels right now. Remember how hard-fought this victory was. Because when we are tested again — and we will be tested again — we’ll need to call on these lessons. We’ll need to summon every ounce of strength and determination to fight. I’m so proud to be part of this movement with you. In solidarity, Eric H. This puts over 58,000 Hoosiers at risk of losing their healthcare coverage in January. Instead of giving working families time to learn a confusing new system and time for the state to ensure compliance and avoid federal penalties, Braun is rushing ahead. Throughout the coming year, you'll enjoy heartwarming images that celebrate the beauty of God's creation, along with special spaces to record your prayers, praises, and blessings each month. But this calendar represents something even more meaningful. Every day across America, women facing unexpected pregnancies are making difficult decisions about their futures and the lives of their preborn babies. Some are frightened. subject: A scream through a hotel wall
body:
One little girl cried out for help. Someone listened. Now she's safe.

| | | |
---
| |
---
| | God's Children Are Not For Sale
---
|
---
| | | Friend,
---
Have you ever heard a sound you just couldn't ignore?

For one woman staying in a hotel, it was the scream of a little girl on the other side of the wall.

I want to introduce you to "Daisy."

But that's not her real name. We'll call her Daisy to protect her privacy.

And her story is why I am writing to you today.

My name is Eduardo Verastegui. I am the producer of the film _Sound of Freedom_ and the new movie _Zero A.D_.: The Birth of Christ, which hits theaters in December.

Years ago, I met rescuers who told me what really happens to children who are trafficked.

It broke my heart.

And it left me with a question I still can't shake...

_What if it were my child_?
---
[ Rescue a Child -- Give Now](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckb1u3DAQhJ-G6izwT38FiwCH65wiCJCSWC-XEmFSVEjKRt4-0F3KVC53d_YbDObXq32FEMO-fodEpjRvS7VQsRCktpV8rhtsuVH8hBit5HJ8EeJFThawhQ-yGjpnHDoQ2JER0zLMfBn10m1G0DyohRbpgQ_zrN8mgEkOehLa4YTYBXPxhJCT5Jxr0UsvhtkPSjuHznHPNIdIpfWFjvMtBoS9QX33uSD1mFMXzdbaUZn6xuSdyXslPAv1NZ-7y94XIpeTvyZoIe99Luulyt46CPXPI48F_M3UveazIFnMjpi6_fh5F6Ma54HJ8WzJJnLhTEzdKEGI_5bPF6ZuGxQH9f1Bep4Q0gFh3Zm6_cftqWlULmJXjDs-Q4yhjhPTfL0cHuna1_r4MPJvAAAA__-lxJ6f)
---
Hollywood said Sound of Freedom would never succeed.

Doors closed. Studios walked away.

**But we refused to give up. **

Because **God 's children are not for sale.**

After the film, I started **Sound of Freedom Foundation** to keep that fight going, long after the credits roll.

Let me show you what that fight looks like.
---
[](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckb1u3DAQhJ-G6izwT38FiwCH65wiCJCSWC-XEmFSVEjKRt4-0F3KVC53d_YbDObXq32FEMO-fodEpjRvS7VQsRCktpV8rhtsuVH8hBit5HJ8EeJFThawhQ-yGjpnHDoQ2JER0zLMfBn10m1G0DyohRbpgQ_zrN8mgEkOehLa4YTYBXPxhJCT5Jxr0UsvhtkPSjuHznHPNIdIpfWFjvMtBoS9QX33uSD1mFMXzdbaUZn6xuSdyXslPAv1NZ-7y94XIpeTvyZoIe99Luulyt46CPXPI48F_M3UveazIFnMjpi6_fh5F6Ma54HJ8WzJJnLhTEzdKEGI_5bPF6ZuGxQH9f1Bep4Q0gFh3Zm6_cftqWlULmJXjDs-Q4yhjhPTfL0cHuna1_r4MPJvAAAA__-lxJ6f)
---
[ Rescue a Child -- Give Now](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckb1u3DAQhJ-G6izwT38FiwCH65wiCJCSWC-XEmFSVEjKRt4-0F3KVC53d_YbDObXq32FEMO-fodEpjRvS7VQsRCktpV8rhtsuVH8hBit5HJ8EeJFThawhQ-yGjpnHDoQ2JER0zLMfBn10m1G0DyohRbpgQ_zrN8mgEkOehLa4YTYBXPxhJCT5Jxr0UsvhtkPSjuHznHPNIdIpfWFjvMtBoS9QX33uSD1mFMXzdbaUZn6xuSdyXslPAv1NZ-7y94XIpeTvyZoIe99Luulyt46CPXPI48F_M3UveazIFnMjpi6_fh5F6Ma54HJ8WzJJnLhTEzdKEGI_5bPF6ZuGxQH9f1Bep4Q0gFh3Zm6_cftqWlULmJXjDs-Q4yhjhPTfL0cHuna1_r4MPJvAAAA__-lxJ6f)
---
Daisy was only ten years old when her own older sister sold her to a trafficker.

She was forced into a taxi and taken to a hotel, where a grown man was waiting to hurt her.

But Daisy fought back. She screamed as loud as she could.

**And the woman next door heard her.**

She tried to get inside. When she couldn't, she ran to the front desk and demanded they call for help.

**Police came. The man was arrested. **

And Daisy was brought straight to one of our safe children's homes.

Friend, rescue is only the beginning.

Daisy came to us with wounds no child should ever carry.

For the next couple of years, she was surrounded by safety, love, counseling, and school.

And by people who reminded her every day:

_What happened to you does not define you. You are valuable. You are loved. You are God 's child. _

Then came the best day of all.

Daisy was placed with her forever family. Today, she is a beloved daughter with a safe home and a bright future.
---
[](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckb1u3DAQhJ-G6izwT38FiwCH65wiCJCSWC-XEmFSVEjKRt4-0F3KVC53d_YbDObXq32FEMO-fodEpjRvS7VQsRCktpV8rhtsuVH8hBit5HJ8EeJFThawhQ-yGjpnHDoQ2JER0zLMfBn10m1G0DyohRbpgQ_zrN8mgEkOehLa4YTYBXPxhJCT5Jxr0UsvhtkPSjuHznHPNIdIpfWFjvMtBoS9QX33uSD1mFMXzdbaUZn6xuSdyXslPAv1NZ-7y94XIpeTvyZoIe99Luulyt46CPXPI48F_M3UveazIFnMjpi6_fh5F6Ma54HJ8WzJJnLhTEzdKEGI_5bPF6ZuGxQH9f1Bep4Q0gFh3Zm6_cftqWlULmJXjDs-Q4yhjhPTfL0cHuna1_r4MPJvAAAA__-lxJ6f)
---
That is what **Sound of Freedom Foundatio** n does. **Rescue. Restore. Raise.**
---
* We help **rescue** children by equipping the brave agents and partners who find them.
* We **restore** survivors with a safe place to heal -- body, mind, and soul.
* We help **raise** them in loving families, so they can grow up free.

---
And we work to stop trafficking before it starts, by helping struggling families and teaching parents the warning signs.
---
[ Rescue a Child -- Give Now](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckb1u3DAQhJ-G6izwT38FiwCH65wiCJCSWC-XEmFSVEjKRt4-0F3KVC53d_YbDObXq32FEMO-fodEpjRvS7VQsRCktpV8rhtsuVH8hBit5HJ8EeJFThawhQ-yGjpnHDoQ2JER0zLMfBn10m1G0DyohRbpgQ_zrN8mgEkOehLa4YTYBXPxhJCT5Jxr0UsvhtkPSjuHznHPNIdIpfWFjvMtBoS9QX33uSD1mFMXzdbaUZn6xuSdyXslPAv1NZ-7y94XIpeTvyZoIe99Luulyt46CPXPI48F_M3UveazIFnMjpi6_fh5F6Ma54HJ8WzJJnLhTEzdKEGI_5bPF6ZuGxQH9f1Bep4Q0gFh3Zm6_cftqWlULmJXjDs-Q4yhjhPTfL0cHuna1_r4MPJvAAAA__-lxJ6f)
---
Jesus said, "_Let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them, for the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these._ " (Matthew 19:14, NIV)

**Every child is precious to God.** And I believe He calls us to protect them.

Here is the hard truth, Friend ...

Human trafficking cases have been reported in all 50 U.S. states. And tonight, another child is crying out behind a locked door.

The woman next door could not open that door by herself. But she made sure help came.

**You can do the same thing today.**

Will you make your first gift to **Sound of Freedom Foundation**?

**[Will you give $25, $50, $75, $100, or whatever you can right now to help rescue, restore, and raise more children like Daisy?](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckb1u3DAQhJ-G6izwT38FiwCH65wiCJCSWC-XEmFSVEjKRt4-0F3KVC53d_YbDObXq32FEMO-fodEpjRvS7VQsRCktpV8rhtsuVH8hBit5HJ8EeJFThawhQ-yGjpnHDoQ2JER0zLMfBn10m1G0DyohRbpgQ_zrN8mgEkOehLa4YTYBXPxhJCT5Jxr0UsvhtkPSjuHznHPNIdIpfWFjvMtBoS9QX33uSD1mFMXzdbaUZn6xuSdyXslPAv1NZ-7y94XIpeTvyZoIe99Luulyt46CPXPI48F_M3UveazIFnMjpi6_fh5F6Ma54HJ8WzJJnLhTEzdKEGI_5bPF6ZuGxQH9f1Bep4Q0gFh3Zm6_cftqWlULmJXjDs-Q4yhjhPTfL0cHuna1_r4MPJvAAAA__-lxJ6f)**

Your gift helps rescue children from trafficking, restore them with love and healing, and give them the chance to grow up in a safe, loving family.

I often say... _when good people keep quiet, they become part of the problem. _

**Please don 't stay quiet. **

**Join us today.**
---
[ Rescue a Child -- Give Now](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckb1u3DAQhJ-G6izwT38FiwCH65wiCJCSWC-XEmFSVEjKRt4-0F3KVC53d_YbDObXq32FEMO-fodEpjRvS7VQsRCktpV8rhtsuVH8hBit5HJ8EeJFThawhQ-yGjpnHDoQ2JER0zLMfBn10m1G0DyohRbpgQ_zrN8mgEkOehLa4YTYBXPxhJCT5Jxr0UsvhtkPSjuHznHPNIdIpfWFjvMtBoS9QX33uSD1mFMXzdbaUZn6xuSdyXslPAv1NZ-7y94XIpeTvyZoIe99Luulyt46CPXPI48F_M3UveazIFnMjpi6_fh5F6Ma54HJ8WzJJnLhTEzdKEGI_5bPF6ZuGxQH9f1Bep4Q0gFh3Zm6_cftqWlULmJXjDs-Q4yhjhPTfL0cHuna1_r4MPJvAAAA__-lxJ6f)

body:
Throughout my life and in Congress, I’ve worked to build consensus, find creative solutions, and fight – for women, for families, and for working people. | | | |
---
| | | Peter, we just made history. **It’s Katherine Clark, and I’m honored to be part of the team that will lead our Caucus as the House Majority Leader in the 120th Congress, and incredibly proud to be the very first woman to hold this position.** I don’t take this lightly. For every woman who was told she couldn't lead, every family fighting to get ahead, and every American who deserves a government that works for them: I am ready for this fight. I am so grateful to have been chosen by my colleagues not only to make history, but also to lead our record-breaking, history-making majority forward as we fight for freedom and economic opportunity, for democracy and for upholding our values, and for every American to have the opportunity to get ahead.
---

By now, most Americans are familiar with the "USAID" agency and Elon Musk's efforts early in Trump 2.0 to dismantle the corrupt federal bureaucracy. But a new document dump posted by DOGE insiders this week shows just how dark the censorship operation USAID ran really was. Here are some highlights from the USAID document dump.
On Jan. 5, 2022, the USAID gave its staff an hour with Daniel Rogers.
Rogers is the co-founder and executive director of the Global Disinformation Index, a nonprofit that rates news sites for "disinformation risk" and supplies ad-tech companies a list of sites to keep ads off. [USAID's notice to staff](https://substack.com/redirect/9f4d7e37-9736-4a43-af9f-88c2f32ad01f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) said the talk, ["Information Disorder and Its Threat to Democracy,"](https://substack.com/redirect/eb22efc5-9f0f-47c1-ac01-4c7c059a5409?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) was part of the "quarterly SEC Guest Speaker Series which aims to help all USAID staff better understand security-related issues impacting our work."
The recording is one of three videos USAID [posted on its website](https://substack.com/redirect/80bafdfb-5112-4012-b9df-269f4e066618?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Tuesday, along with 242 PDFs and three spreadsheets, under the banner "USAID Files." The page says that under previous administrations, "USAID was weaponized to advance a radical agenda fundamentally at odds with American values."
Edward Coristine, the former DOGE staffer known as "Big Balls," [announced the release on X](https://substack.com/redirect/bd499f30-48bb-46e3-a425-11cae1694213?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Tuesday: "Now on USAID.gov, you can read internal memos and communications showing how the agency actually operated behind the scenes."
Rogers told the "131 of us" on the call that true-or-false tests of disinformation don't work for him. "To kind of rely on purely, is this fact true or not, to me as a scientist feels almost like an impossible standard," he said.
"To kind of rely on purely, is this fact true or not, to me as a scientist feels almost like an impossible standard," he said.

His first example was Breitbart News, which he said is "widely considered in the community at this point" to be "a frequent peddler of disinformation." Rogers said the site's "Crimes by Illegal Aliens" section was made of local news stories, and that "if you fact check the bulk of these stories, they would fact check to be correct."
That was the problem. Accurate stories, collected in one place, made "a sort of implicit narrative that is intentionally misleading that is built using cherry-picked elements of the truth," he said.
Then he described GDI's argument with Breitbart over a headline quoting Rudy Giuliani. "By simply quoting Rudy Giuliani and not explaining in your article that there's no basis in, you know, fact for what he's saying, you're furthering this adversarial narrative, even if technically speaking, you know, what you wrote is true that he did say this," Rogers said.
Under this Orwellian standard, a story can be true and still be disinformation. (You can't help but wonder whether this same standard would apply to, say, Secretary of State Shenna Bellows saying Maine has the "gold-standard" in election integrity...)
The real chokepoint Rogers wanted the federal government to zero in on was the flow of money to websites publishing non-approved information. Rogers told staff that GDI had estimated $200 million to $250 million was being spent on ads across the sites it tracks and deems high risk. Working with ad-tech companies, he said, "by our estimates," GDI had "cut that funding in half."
Johnny Walsh, then USAID's deputy assistant administrator for democracy, human rights and governance, ran the questions. "The work you're doing is amazing," he told Rogers.
Walsh asked for an example of a counter-disinformation campaign that worked. Rogers picked the 2020 New York Post story on Hunter Biden's laptop. He credited groups like First Draft, which he said "had been spending four years going around the newsrooms explaining what a disinformation campaign looked like." He called it a "weirdly fake" and "stolen Hunter Biden laptop story." Almost every outlet that got it, he said, "didn't give it oxygen except for the New York Post. And it kind of stopped it dead in its tracks."
Of course, now we know the "counter-disinformation" campaign the federal government was running in cahoots with big tech was itself disinformation. The laptop was real. Hunter Biden has admitted as much. In June 2024, [an FBI agent testified](https://substack.com/redirect/f1bef830-f479-431e-87a5-7d583b6f4e8d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at Hunter Biden's gun trial that it was his.
Five months after the talk, an official at the Office of the Director of National Intelligence, whose name is blacked out in the file, [introduced Rogers and GDI co-founder Clare Melford to Walsh](https://substack.com/redirect/92a73c11-49d0-4f9c-b0a7-1734f4e522d1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The official called GDI "the best organization I know working on the commercial, for-profit side of the disinformation challenge."
To translate: GDI was trying to harass advertisers and ad networks until they stopped spending money on websites that were not aligned with the Biden Administration's policies.
Walsh brought in Vera Zakem, "our new Senior Advisor for Tech and Democracy and overall lead on disinformation." After a July 14, 2022, call, Walsh [sent GDI a list of 10 countries](https://substack.com/redirect/873693bf-6e2b-44cd-b96e-98f8b0345b80?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and asked for "a one-pager on whether/how we might collaborate to help them." Zakem wrote: "We're looking forward to receiving the concept note!"
[The concept note came in August 2022](https://substack.com/redirect/c35e2350-5827-48b9-abef-5918322ba8d2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). GDI proposed rating news outlets in Moldova, Zambia and Armenia, with "risk ratings per site that can be shared privately with USAID." It also proposed a "USAID / Platform Intervention Pilot," because "USAID has indicated that its growing relationships with the large online platforms, including Alphabet [aka Google] and Meta [aka Facebook / Instagram], offer an opportunity to take action in these three countries based on the data that GDI's MMRs produce." MMRs are the group's media market reviews.
The pilot had three parts: "Defund," "Downrank" and "Deplatform." The last meant working "with platforms to block or eliminate the most egregious disinformation peddlers in these countries that violate existing platform policies."
The note also said that GDI's exclusion list of "2500+ worst offending disinformation sites" was "embedded in the systems of thirteen global ad tech companies." The files The Robinson Report reviewed don't show that USAID paid GDI or that the pilot went forward.
## Censoring Facebook and Twitter
The USAID files also detail precisely how the federal agency worked with Big Tech to censor social media when narratives appeared that ran counter to the Biden Administration's prerogatives.
On July 2, 2022, the National Democratic Institute told Facebook that one of its partners in Libya was receiving threats from a Facebook page "calling for a gathering" at the partner's office. Brendan Wheeler, USAID/Libya's democracy and governance officer, [forwarded it to two Facebook staffers](https://substack.com/redirect/85967aa4-5520-4113-85e3-f668217967a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that night.
"We join NDI in requesting that Facebook take prompt action to remove these posts and suspend the page in question," Wheeler wrote. Two days later he followed up: "USAID/Libya is concerned to see that this page continues to post content that we believe is threatening to our partners."
On July 19, a Facebook staffer wrote that the page and posts had been "actioned." NDI confirmed the next day that they were gone.
If that sounds familiar, it's precisely what happened when Maine Sen. Angus King was running for re-election in 2018. Documents released after Elon Musk acquired Twitter (now X) showed that Angus King's re-election campaign, working via [DrummondWoodsum stooge Toby McGrath](https://substack.com/redirect/4c3cd91a-07ec-4a5a-bc08-3f4d3ef6c3b0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), leaned on [Facebook and Twitter](https://substack.com/redirect/de69d6a7-3672-4736-a73c-0211755d38b3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to censor posts that were critical of King -- even though the accounts were posting factually accurate information about King, including clips of King speaking at campaign events and comparing the 2016 election to Pearl Harbor or 9/11. The documents showed McGrath handing tech execs [King's enemies list](https://substack.com/redirect/16ce67d2-8d61-4a0e-95c4-835c55ca2418?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), with the obvious context that those accounts ought to be censored.
[Share The Robinson Report](https://substack..nOEPpgmF1WzTSzXtYYxpV42CmbOEAug9BNZCfeoENoc?)
Back to the USAID files: On Aug. 16, 2022, Maureen Nealon, program manager for Sudan in USAID's Office of Transition Initiatives, [emailed Facebook about a post](https://substack.com/redirect/304e4887-b515-40e6-aa74-54864e5c03e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that named 38 staff members of Chemonics, a USAID contractor, "falsely accusing them of being CIA operatives." She wrote that "we are requesting assistance in getting the post taken down immediately," and that "it appears to be a Russian disinformation page, but we don't have confirmation yet." The file doesn't show Facebook's answer. Based on what we know about USAID now, there's a 99% chance those Chemonics staffers were, in fact, CIA operatives.
Both requests cited threats to named people. Both also show how short the line was between a USAID officer and the people at Facebook who could take a page down.
The flagging went further than email. In August 2022, Josh Machleder, USAID's senior media and internet freedom advisor, [passed along an offer from YouTube](https://substack.com/redirect/3a86ce2d-0996-47a2-9f22-777ccb6570ae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to Internews, a USAID partner. "Our contacts at YouTube said that if there are local groups that would be recommended to serve as 'Trusted Flaggers' that we should send over a list of potential organizations for consideration," he wrote.
Rafiq Copeland, an Internews senior advisor, declined to send partner contacts. But he added: "between various partners and sub-awards I am pretty sure USAID is currently funding a lot of staff around the world to flag issues to the platforms through these trusted programs."
In other words, USAID was spreading taxpayer dollars all over the world to leftists who would then help censor the Internet in favor of leftist narratives.
By mid-2024, the agency's lawyers were worried about how this looked.
[Notes for a July 8, 2024, presentation](https://substack.com/redirect/fe5cd697-4d32-433f-ab3e-3b834c382edd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by Chioma Ayogu, then USAID's acting assistant general counsel for Africa, came days after the Supreme Court ruled in Murthy v. Missouri, the social media censorship case. The court threw it out because the plaintiffs lacked standing. The notes say the guidance for staff didn't change.
"Keep it factual. Keep it out of the Washington Post," the notes say. "USAID cannot be perceived to be policing public opinion or categorizing all negative views of USAID's work as misinformation." (Translation: "We don't want USAID being perceived as doing what it does.")
"USAID doesn't badger tech companies," the notes say, mendaciously. If the mission, the regional bureau and the technical office had all "called Meta to the carpet over the same trusted partners program," the notes said, "it helps fuel the narrative," and they spelled out the narrative: "Why is USAID still asking unless the intent is to coerce the tech company to do something. That is, USAID says it is not coercing tech companies, but do its actions say otherwise?"
Further demonstrating the agency's own sense that what they were doing was wrong, if not illegal, the guidance specifically instructs staff to avoid creating records that could be obtained via FOIA requests: "Write emails and gchats as if you expect them to get FOIA'd or requested by the Hill."
Thanks to Big Balls, no one needed to file the FOIA request.
A year earlier, [a July 2023 program review](https://substack.com/redirect/2d17a2e6-d0a8-4f55-8b31-12fb995361cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) prepared for USAID by NORC at the University of Chicago had looked at whether USAID's censorship work was paying off. It found that "fact-checking and working directly with social media companies to improve content moderation, generally appear to work less well but might still have value in specific situations." It said "the USAID programs in this review struggled to interface effectively with platforms." And it said "little evidence" suggests that monitoring this material on social media "is a useful way of reducing the volume of MDM," the agency's shorthand for mis-, dis- and malinformation, "or spurring change within platforms themselves."
None of the USAID censorship brokers fell into ruin after Elon Musk crushed the agency into dust.
Rogers still runs GDI and teaches at New York University, according to [a declaration he filed this year](https://substack.com/redirect/2e29c0a4-0a70-4c05-9b2a-f86860b7fb0a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in federal court in Washington. In that filing, he said the State Department named Melford, the GDI co-founder, in December 2025 as one of five people it was sanctioning and barring from the United States.
Walsh left USAID in 2025. He is now a [senior fellow at the Center for American Progress](https://substack.com/redirect/0084befa-4793-4e44-8003-495c4f734e68?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a leftist think tank where wrinkled progressives go to collect paychecks.
Zakem became USAID's chief digital democracy and rights officer. Gov. Gavin Newsom [appointed her California](https://substack.com/redirect/c2c94306-1b12-4d4d-ab55-8e76b7869f3c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s state chief technology innovation officer in February 2025.
Machleder [directs a program at the National Endowment for Democracy](https://substack.com/redirect/09322099-6a39-4297-9353-081bf7814005?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Ayogu is a senior assistant general counsel at Social Finance, a nonprofit, according to her LinkedIn posts.
Wheeler's Foreign Service career ended when USAID closed. This fall, he [wrote in the Foreign Service Journal](https://substack.com/redirect/6980ae2a-7a6e-4bb2-a0c0-59723e382b13?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that the agency is "ripe for the Church Committee treatment," which he described as "an honest, clinical reckoning that exposes weaknesses and strengths by telling Americans the full story."

Zakem gave about $3,400 to Democratic candidates and committees from 2008 to 2024, including Barack Obama, Hillary Clinton, Joe Biden and Kamala Harris. In December 2023, while at USAID, she listed her employer as "GOVT" and her occupation as "TECH & DEMOCRACY."
Machleder gave about $1,250 from 2016 to 2024, listing USAID, "GOVT" or, in 2024, the National Endowment for Democracy as his employer. Recipients include Clinton, Biden, Harris and Pete Buttigieg.
Walsh gave about $600 from 2018 to 2020, while at the U.S. Institute of Peace, to Biden, Democratic House candidates Andy Kim, Elissa Slotkin and Tom Malinowski, and a Georgia Democratic Senate fund during the 2020 runoffs.
Ayogu gave about $380 from 2018 to 2025, listing the Department of Transportation as her employer, to Democrats including Biden, Cory Booker, Raphael Warnock and Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez.
Rogers gave about $3,270 from 2017 to 2026, listing GDI or his earlier company, Terbium Labs. Recipients include Sen. Elizabeth Warren, Rep. Pat Ryan of New York, Warnock and Sen. Jon Ossoff.
The files are [posted at usaid.gov](https://substack.com/redirect/80bafdfb-5112-4012-b9df-269f4e066618?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

The laptop was real. Hunter Biden has admitted as much. In June 2024, at Hunter Biden's gun trial that it was his. Five months after the talk, an official at the Office of the Director of National Intelligence, whose name is blacked out in the file, . The official called GDI "the best organization I know working on the commercial, for-profit side of the disinformation challenge." To translate: GDI was trying to harass advertisers and ad networks until they stopped spending money on websites that were not aligned with the Biden Administration's policies. Walsh brought in Vera Zakem, "our new Senior Advisor for Tech and Democracy and overall lead on disinformation." After a July 14, 2022, call, Walsh and asked for "a one-pager on whether/how we might collaborate to help them." Zakem wrote: "We're looking forward to receiving the concept note!" . GDI proposed rating news outlets in Moldova, Zambia and Armenia, with "risk ratings per site that can be shared privately with USAID." It also proposed a "USAID / Platform Intervention Pilot," because "USAID has indicated that its growing relationships with the large online platforms, including Alphabet [aka Google] and Meta [aka Facebook / Instagram], offer an opportunity to take action in these three countries based on the data that GDI's MMRs produce." MMRs are the group's media market reviews. The pilot had three parts: "Defund," "Downrank" and "Deplatform." The last meant working "with platforms to block or eliminate the most egregious disinformation peddlers in these countries that violate existing platform policies." The note also said that GDI's exclusion list of "2500+ worst offending disinformation sites" was "embedded in the systems of thirteen global ad tech companies." The files The Robinson Report reviewed don't show that USAID paid GDI or that the pilot went forward. Censoring Facebook and Twitter The USAID files also detail precisely how the federal agency worked with Big Tech to censor social media when narratives appeared that ran counter to the Biden Administration's prerogatives. On July 2, 2022, the National Democratic Institute told Facebook that one of its partners in Libya was receiving threats from a Facebook page "calling for a gathering" at the partner's office. Brendan Wheeler, USAID/Libya's democracy and governance officer, that night. "We join NDI in requesting that Facebook take prompt action to remove these posts and suspend the page in question," Wheeler wrote. Two days later he followed up: "USAID/Libya is concerned to see that this page continues to post content that we believe is threatening to our partners." On July 19, a Facebook staffer wrote that the page and posts had been "actioned." NDI confirmed the next day that they were gone. If that sounds familiar, it's precisely what happened when Maine Sen. Angus King was running for re-election in 2018. Documents released after Elon Musk acquired Twitter (now X) showed that Angus King's re-election campaign, working via , leaned on to censor posts that were critical of King -- even though the accounts were posting factually accurate information about King, including clips of King speaking at campaign events and comparing the 2016 election to Pearl Harbor or 9/11. The documents showed McGrath handing tech execs , with the obvious context that those accounts ought to be censored. ? Back to the USAID files: On Aug. 16, 2022, Maureen Nealon, program manager for Sudan in USAID's Office of Transition Initiatives, that named 38 staff members of Chemonics, a USAID contractor, "falsely accusing them of being CIA operatives." She wrote that "we are requesting assistance in getting the post taken down immediately," and that "it appears to be a Russian disinformation page, but we don't have confirmation yet." The file doesn't show Facebook's answer. Based on what we know about USAID now, there's a 99% chance those Chemonics staffers were, in fact, CIA operatives. Both requests cited threats to named people. Both also show how short the line was between a USAID officer and the people at Facebook who could take a page down. The flagging went further than email. In August 2022, Josh Machleder, USAID's senior media and internet freedom advisor, to Internews, a USAID partner. "Our contacts at YouTube said that if there are local groups that would be recommended to serve as 'Trusted Flaggers' that we should send over a list of potential organizations for consideration," he wrote. Rafiq Copeland, an Internews senior advisor, declined to send partner contacts. But he added: "between various partners and sub-awards I am pretty sure USAID is currently funding a lot of staff around the world to flag issues to the platforms through these trusted programs." In other words, USAID was spreading taxpayer dollars all over the world to leftists who would then help censor the Internet in favor of leftist narratives. By mid-2024, the agency's lawyers were worried about how this looked. by Chioma Ayogu, then USAID's acting assistant general counsel for Africa, came days after the Supreme Court ruled in Murthy v. Missouri, the social media censorship case. The court threw it out because the plaintiffs lacked standing. The notes say the guidance for staff didn't change. "Keep it factual. Keep it out of the Washington Post," the notes say. "USAID cannot be perceived to be policing public opinion or categorizing all negative views of USAID's work as misinformation." (Translation: "We don't want USAID being perceived as doing what it does.") "USAID doesn't badger tech companies," the notes say, mendaciously. If the mission, the regional bureau and the technical office had all "called Meta to the carpet over the same trusted partners program," the notes said, "it helps fuel the narrative," and they spelled out the narrative: "Why is USAID still asking unless the intent is to coerce the tech company to do something. That is, USAID says it is not coercing tech companies, but do its actions say otherwise?" Further demonstrating the agency's own sense that what they were doing was wrong, if not illegal, the guidance specifically instructs staff to avoid creating records that could be obtained via FOIA requests: "Write emails and gchats as if you expect them to get FOIA'd or requested by the Hill." Thanks to Big Balls, no one needed to file the FOIA request. A year earlier, prepared for USAID by NORC at the University of Chicago had looked at whether USAID's censorship work was paying off. It found that "fact-checking and working directly with social media companies to improve content moderation, generally appear to work less well but might still have value in specific situations." It said "the USAID programs in this review struggled to interface effectively with platforms." And it said "little evidence" suggests that monitoring this material on social media "is a useful way of reducing the volume of MDM," the agency's shorthand for mis-, dis- and malinformation, "or spurring change within platforms themselves." None of the USAID censorship brokers fell into ruin after Elon Musk crushed the agency into dust. Rogers still runs GDI and teaches at New York University, according to in federal court in Washington. In that filing, he said the State Department named Melford, the GDI co-founder, in December 2025 as one of five people it was sanctioning and barring from the United States. Walsh left USAID in 2025. He is now a , a leftist think tank where wrinkled progressives go to collect paychecks. Zakem became USAID's chief digital democracy and rights officer. Gov. Gavin Newsom state chief technology innovation officer in February 2025. Machleder . Ayogu is a senior assistant general counsel at Social Finance, a nonprofit, according to her LinkedIn posts. Wheeler's Foreign Service career ended when USAID closed. This fall, he that the agency is "ripe for the Church Committee treatment," which he described as "an honest, clinical reckoning that exposes weaknesses and strengths by telling Americans the full story." In December 2023, while at USAID, she listed her employer as "GOVT" and her occupation as "TECH & DEMOCRACY." Machleder gave about $1,250 from 2016 to 2024, listing USAID, "GOVT" or, in 2024, the National Endowment for Democracy as his employer. Recipients include Clinton, Biden, Harris and Pete Buttigieg. Walsh gave about $600 from 2018 to 2020, while at the U.S. Institute of Peace, to Biden, Democratic House candidates Andy Kim, Elissa Slotkin and Tom Malinowski, and a Georgia Democratic Senate fund during the 2020 runoffs. Ayogu gave about $380 from 2018 to 2025, listing the Department of Transportation as her employer, to Democrats including Biden, Cory Booker, Raphael Warnock and Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez. Rogers gave about $3,270 from 2017 to 2026, listing GDI or his earlier company, Terbium Labs. Recipients include Sen. Elizabeth Warren, Rep. Pat Ryan of New York, Warnock and Sen. Jon Ossoff. name: Mark Levin
subject: If they can do it to Trump, they can do it to you
body:
Or to me. Or to anyone else who refuses to bow to their wishes.

*|MC_PREVIEW_TEXT|* |
---
| | [](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckLuK8zAQhZ9G7myskXxJoeKH4C5_u6WZSLIzrG5Y4yz79ksC-wLbngPn8n3c1htSoLT_x-gN1boedaWNH_7bYnKZmDMfZyxvZYUexlbKFqYVLdPTrxobZwaQ8zY33sjpMswSlNTNw4yD7J3SYJ2927sdHMhtnPX9cplwmCbVkHnlSQkT9HqQuhuUQnDOe9fL0eModH8Wh-w7SpWcrzbnUnIgJlu7fOxNMA_mUoX6J2ARsFRvz8N3mLzL3NkcBSwBk4t4fLbB7xjaLZ_JIVNOApaC7etITkItJ8fVYixIexLq-rtNwPh2cmKfWKgr1docxpUvCoHqOAnd7xEpvOoa_iPEp4GfAAAA___nvoQo)
Friend,

What leftists did to Donald Trump last time they held power made me sick.

You remember what happened; these radicals turned the justice system into an injustice system in their mad pursuit of their hated enemy.

They invented phony charges, violated statutes of limitations, and mounted preposterous prosecutions to get Trump.

**And if they could do it to him, they can do it to you. Or to me. Or to anyone else who refuses to bow to their wishes.**

This was never all about Trump. It's about the rule of law. It's about the Constitution. It's about basic fairness.

I've never seen anything like this in our country.

Now the midterms are over. And in January, the Left takes control of both houses of Congress.

**They 've got their chance. And you know as well as I do that they are going to do it all over again.**

**This is an alarming wake-up call. A warning to Americans across the country to fight for our constitutional rights and our free-market system.**

This is why I'm fighting back against these appalling injustices. ## Ukrainian Couple Reunites After Years
Larysa Ryndova hurried to see her husband as if she were going on a first date. She put on makeup and spritzed perfume in the car. It had been four and a half years since she had seen 68-year-old Serhiy, who had been trapped in the [Russian-occupied town of Oleshky](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2OpDAUhE9jMiP_gKEDB5uQ9aYbImM_6NdrbGQeIG4_6pHmBJNWSaX6vn_P8ekwYlr-uhXsvMwjzXlMcO0RiKCMBY6EBMFRdDut905Q7jUnGJVQhkvJVTc6T3jCKKtgZwAFugIru0fbS61kV73sNMt2BtGGaTKm9zD5XvePzoleQ9DQVGg_c1KqTkkhZFsr00BvjJbBg2mCZo2AgJRL_c6Y6AVzvPMJpfZ5raJ9EW0703-YGpgaruuqCxwEZf_0nySXGJga4Ch5A6YGAld2_s43P_4Xhwld4j4fWwQe8MQAgU83z94fmyPMia8AxN3iMPEfcvFgaqiKDduFMeJuOtaIZXUYv1_R732eVn0FAAD__yzSjeE) in southern Ukraine. Larysa fled to England in 2022 to live with their son, three months into the occupation. Serhiy stayed behind to look after their home. He survived on stockpiled humanitarian aid, mostly noodles and grains, with occasional canned meat and fish. On Oct. 30, he was finally evacuated with hundreds of other residents during a ceasefire. Larysa made the [1,200-mile journey](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGO3DAMRU8jdxpI9Iy8U6hI427TpjS4Ej3DjSwZEm3Dtw8cICdIRzwCH__9X5_TJ3Li_PqJC_n5NU8ylynT0RKJUJ0qbZmFIkrCJsvZhOq5lEwTGHDaWg3DhEF4p8l20c9EQH1H3g7Px4ftwQ7d20fnDPRkgnmSHSxgnOHrAQ-YAzmAoWN_xVkLA1hj7OMG7k4fzvU2BnL32Ku7ochS6u27cJY3zeksO9VbKEuX_Ftkbar_oWBUMB7HcdvaZXG9FYzXefFSU1QwYhUOiS70z8I8FYxCWJvGHPV3OTU2vf2uyJkx61C2NZGOvHOkqL9OXULYVhQuWS9EovGFnLvq43pwStzcoO7mtSCnvx3l_9fdPfwJAAD__1Eakfg) to Kyiv to meet him. “ _I can’t believe you are here_ ,” Larysa, 72, kept repeating, mascara smudged with tears, when they embraced outside a hospital in Kyiv. “ _Honestly, I can’t believe it myself_ ,” Serhiy replied. Today, we're telling the story of how Black Friday got its name. So what did the name originally mean, and why did it stick? All of that and more on The Feel Good Flyover Podcast. ! She put on makeup and spritzed perfume in the car. It had been four and a half years since she had seen 68-year-old Serhiy, who had been trapped in the in southern Ukraine. Larysa fled to England in 2022 to live with their son, three months into the occupation. Serhiy stayed behind to look after their home. He survived on stockpiled humanitarian aid, mostly noodles and grains, with occasional canned meat and fish. On Oct. 30, he was finally evacuated with hundreds of other residents during a ceasefire. Larysa made the to Kyiv to meet him. “ I can’t believe you are here ,” Larysa, 72, kept repeating, mascara smudged with tears, when they embraced outside a hospital in Kyiv. “ Honestly, I can’t believe it myself ,” Serhiy replied. He said he could have survived another winter. Larysa rolled her eyes, still wet with tears. “ I’ll fatten him up with borscht and varenyky ,” . $55K Found in Woods to Heat Homes Four years ago, a hiker in Falmouth, Maine, stumbled across an abandoned safe in the woods. When police cut it open, they found . They traced the bills to a bank in New Hampshire and confirmed the money wasn’t stolen, but despite newspaper notices and a years-long search, nobody ever claimed it. Under Maine law, unclaimed money of this kind must go to a charitable purpose. This month, the Falmouth Town Council voted to direct the money to the , helping families pay heating bills this winter. Independent journalist Nick Sortor **[confronted Democrat Rep. Jamie Raskin](https://substack.com/redirect/283c635f-9aa3-4489-a8a7-e6a584ead61d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in the streets of D.C. over his support for now self-deported illegal alien and suspected MS-13 gang affiliate Kilmar Abrego Garcia, causing the congressman to lash out in a child-like rage.
"You look ridiculous! Do you think Marylanders want illegal criminal gangbangers coming into their cities?!!" Sortor pressed Raskin. "Do you support criminal illegals being deported at least?!!"
Abrego Garcia reportedly self-deported to Spain earlier this week, leaving Democrats like Raskin holding the bag on their crusade to defend him.
## Watch the confrontation here:
[](https://substack.com/redirect/283c635f-9aa3-4489-a8a7-e6a584ead61d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Click To Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/283c635f-9aa3-4489-a8a7-e6a584ead61d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
# **Hackers breach US Air Force 's Cloud One platform**
Hackers infiltrated Cloud One, the Air Force's primary cloud computing system, potentially exposing tactical, personnel, and logistics data, **[Reuters reported](https://substack.com/redirect/e50e4351-050e-4649-83e7-0b515a82269f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , citing sources who discovered the breach roughly a month ago during an upgrade.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e50e4351-050e-4649-83e7-0b515a82269f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Attackers reportedly exploited a software vulnerability to access the platform 's control plane,** described as providing "universal remote" access; Cyber Command was brought in to assess damage, and migration of back-office applications to the platform has been paused.
* **The breach adds to a string of recent cyber incidents** affecting the FBI, Pentagon, DHS, and Treasury Department, raising broader concerns about AI-powered intrusions targeting cloud networks, though it remains unclear whether AI played any role in this attack or its detection.

* * *
# **Trump chats with F-16 pilot during Thanksgiving military calls**
President Donald Trump **[called service members](https://substack.com/redirect/fdfd9387-09c0-451d-88c3-16d6869762cf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** across all six military branches from Mar-a-Lago on Thanksgiving, including an exchange with Air Force Lt. Col. Brant Smith, who called the F-16 the "world's greatest fighter jet" over the F-22 and F-35.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/77d1d0ff-1c15-4049-b042-531b6f315223?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Click To Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/77d1d0ff-1c15-4049-b042-531b6f315223?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Smith, deployed with an F-16 squadron supporting operations near the Strait of Hormuz, told Trump** the unit has flown over 2,000 sorties across 12,000-plus hours this year, including as part of Operation Epic Fury against Iran.
* **Trump praised the squadron 's combat successes** and said Iran's economy and military capabilities are deteriorating, pointing to the recent deployment of an additional aircraft carrier, the USS Theodore Roosevelt, to the region.

* * *
# **Anthropic employee claims Riemann Hypothesis proof with Claude 's help**
Anthropic employee Levent Alpoge announced **[he may have solved the 167-year-old Riemann Hypothesis](https://substack.com/redirect/7e60710e-53b2-4483-b570-a0058892e104?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** using Claude Fable 5.2, delaying the announcement until after Anthropic's IPO; some mathematicians have since expressed "full confidence" in the proof's validity.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7e60710e-53b2-4483-b570-a0058892e104?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Alp oge, a Harvard and Princeton-trained mathematician who joined Anthropic in 2024,** credited much of the breakthrough to Claude, writing that he "guided" the process but that the AI "far outpaced" him near the end.
* **Alp oge called the proof's timing difficult** given his personal connection to the problem since childhood, but expressed optimism that the work signals a broader wave of mathematical discovery still to come.

* * *
# **Holiday fraud remains widespread as scammers target shoppers, travelers**
An AARP study found **[84% of American adults have been targeted by fraud,](https://substack.com/redirect/14b6546c-c577-405b-a5dd-85f8b6f1561f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with common scams including fake shipment notifications, unpaid toll texts, and fraudulent online ads; Americans lost $15.9 billion to fraud in 2025, including over $503 million from non-delivery scams.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/14b6546c-c577-405b-a5dd-85f8b6f1561f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Experts warn of holiday-specific threats like fake charities,** seasonal job scams, and AI-generated "grandparent scams" using deepfaked voices to trick older adults into sending money; victims are typically legally liable for funds sent to scammers, with banks rarely offering reimbursement.
* **New risks include agentic AI tools that can make transactions on a consumer 's behalf,** which experts say remain insecure; officials recommend avoiding suspicious links, using credit cards for online purchases, and holding mail during travel to prevent package theft.

Derek, this is an email inviting you to chip in for a chance to meet Senator Warren in Boston or DC. Every gift helps elect a Democrat to the White House and keep control of Congress. If you'd like to stop receiving emails about this contest, please [click here.](https://ak.democrats.org/signup/warren-sweepstakes-2026-opt-out/?t=2&akid=10383%2E22930333%2ELGV7Ld) | [](https://ak.democrats.org/go/2234?c0=em-warren-sweepstakes-2026.k_RvmO&amount=7&refcode=em_20261127_10383_fr&t=3&akid=10383%2E22930333%2ELGV7Ld)

Derek,
Democrats’ historic victories earlier this month weren’t an accident. Trump’s historic unpopularity didn’t make them inevitable. Democrats won these races, and races up and down the ballot all over the country, because we fought hard for it.
The DNC has been working day in and day out to secure these victories for almost two years:
They invested more than $1 million every single month in state parties.
Their organizing team has been laser-focused on expanding the map and building Democratic power at all levels — reaching tens of millions of voters to turn them out to the polls.
They trained tens of thousands of Democrats, from voter protection volunteers to organizers for Senate races.
All of that and more was possible **_thanks to you, the DNC’s team of grassroots supporters.**_ That’s why I’m thrilled to meet one DNC supporter and a friend in Boston or DC this winter. I want to thank you, in person, for all you’ve done to help power Democrats to victory.

---
| | Friends, On this Thanksgiving, I wanted to drop a note to express my deepest gratitude to each and every one of you. When I started my campaign, I had no idea what I was doing. Yes, I talked to insiders, hired the “experts,” consulted with former candidates. But it isn’t until you actually run for federal office that you can fully understand the dirty politics, the impact on your life and family, and the role money plays in elections. However, my biggest takeaway from this rollercoaster of a ride is the true ability of a person, neighborhoods, local DFL offices, book clubs, groups of angry citizens, running clubs, Indivisible Groups, small business owners, farmers, Veterans, YOU, to make a difference in this country. Wow. For all the postcards written, calls and texts sent, community rallies, fundraisers, meet-and-greets, parades, signs delivered and displayed, volunteer hours, donations, and conversations, thank you. I will be eternally grateful for your trust, dedication, passion, support, empathy, and fight. It is hard to put into words the profound gratitude and humility I feel when I think about you believing in me, my message, and our campaign. I know we did not get the result we hoped for, and I live with that disappointment. But life has a way of putting you where you need to be, at the time you need to be there. I am not done. clean_body: | | | | | Friends, On this Thanksgiving, I wanted to drop a note to express my deepest gratitude to each and every one of you. When I started my campaign, I had no idea what I was doing. Yes, I talked to insiders, hired the “experts,” consulted with former candidates. But it isn’t until you actually run for federal office that you can fully understand the dirty politics, the impact on your life and family, and the role money plays in elections. However, my biggest takeaway from this rollercoaster of a ride is the true ability of a person, neighborhoods, local DFL offices, book clubs, groups of angry citizens, running clubs, Indivisible Groups, small business owners, farmers, Veterans, YOU, to make a difference in this country. Wow. For all the postcards written, calls and texts sent, community rallies, fundraisers, meet-and-greets, parades, signs delivered and displayed, volunteer hours, donations, and conversations, thank you. I will be eternally grateful for your trust, dedication, passion, support, empathy, and fight. It is hard to put into words the profound gratitude and humility I feel when I think about you believing in me, my message, and our campaign. I know we did not get the result we hoped for, and I live with that disappointment. But life has a way of putting you where you need to be, at the time you need to be there. I am not done. We are not done. We have one life to live. One voice to advocate for what we believe in. One country to fight for because we can always do better. = | | | Until our tomorrow, please remember how grateful I am for your support.
