subject: 2 sisters, 1 rope, and 1 radio call
body:
The older sister didn't scream. That's what I can't forget.

| [View in Web Browser](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e11034496/VaHR0cHM6Ly93cm8ubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YvZWtXamN3VFZmRg/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjExMjc/LbmNsV0dLQ012cA/qP2hpZHM9bmM3eVpTcmRSU2daMzVscw/gawoQpQ/sarf93e5b71)
| | | [](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
| |
---
| | GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE
---
|
---
| | | Friend,
---
The call blasted across the police radio: "We need backup—NOW!" Officers ran. Inside a tiny shack, they found two sisters. One was five years old; the other was twenty months – still a baby. **Both were tied by their ankles... and hanging upside down from the roof.** I'll call them Ana and Lucía. Those are not their real names. But this is their true story. One officer reached for the baby first and began cutting her down. Ana was still hanging beside her, waiting. She didn't scream; she didn't kick or cry or fight the rope. She just watched. **To her, this was normal.**
---
[ Help Protect the Next Children Like Ana and Lucía ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Friend, I have heard many rescue stories since the movie _Sound of Freedom_ came out. **This is one I cannot shake.** Ana and Lucía had been hurt by the very adults who were supposed to protect them. Hurt in ways I cannot – will not – describe to you. The ropes had cut deep into their ankles. Those marks would become scars. _But that day, everything changed._ SOMEONE noticed. SOMEONE made the call. And SOMEONE answered. The officers carried both girls out of that shack. They were placed in a safe home through our program partner, House Parent Project. **Now let me tell you what happened next.** For more than three years, their house parents have fed them, tucked them in, and prayed over them every night. They have watched Ana and Lucía heal... grow... and laugh. Both girls go to school now. And little by little, they have learned something no child should ever have to learn: **Hands are meant to protect. Not hurt.** Today, they are thriving. And Friend, here is the part that makes me want to drop to my knees in thanks... **A loving family has stepped forward to adopt them.** Both of them. _Together._ That family is going through the approval process right now. The scars around their ankles tell where they have been. But they will never determine where they are going. Soon, two little girls who once hung from the roof of a shack will walk through the front door of their forever home.
---
[ Help Protect the Next Children Like Ana and Lucía ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Friend, here is what I cannot stop thinking about: Ana didn't scream. **She had learned that no one was coming – but she was wrong.** _**[Yet somewhere tonight, another child has learned that same terrible lesson, waiting for someone to answer the call – Friend, will that someone be you?](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**_ That is why Sound of Freedom Foundation exists: to stop the sale of God's children. Thanks to the unwavering support of concerned, caring people like you, we equip the rescue partners who go in when the call comes. And through House Parent Project, your support will help us give rescued children what Ana and Lucía found: SAFE homes, LOVING house parents, and trauma-informed CARE. **Because rescue is only the beginning. A rope can be cut in a minute, but healing takes years.** _**[Friend, your most generous, tax-deductible gift today helps make both possible.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**_ The Bible says, "God sets the lonely in families" (Psalm 68:6). I believe that with my whole heart. And now I get to watch Him do it for two little sisters. _**[Friend, will you give $25, $50, $75, $100, or whatever God puts on your heart to help protect the next child?](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**_
---
[ Yes, I Will Answer the Call to Help Protect the Next Children Like Ana and Lucía ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Ana and Lucía were found, but the next child is still waiting. _Let's answer for her too._ **GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE.**
---
With gratitude and prayer,
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Eduardo Verástegui
Producer, _Sound of Freedom_
For Sound of Freedom Foundation

Someone did, and soon they will walk into their forever home together. _**[Friend, your gift of $25, $50, or more today helps protect the next child who is still waiting.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**_

name: America Fitzpatrick, LCV
subject: TAKE ACTION: Protect polar bear habitat in the Arctic Refuge!
body:
Speak out against seismic testing for oil

If you are unable to see the message below, [click here to view](https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTQxMTIyNzcS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjU4MDEwNjA4MAS2&mt=1&rt=0).
| | | |
---
| | | |
## **Protect Polar Bear Habitat — Speak Out Against Seismic Testing for Oil in the Arctic Refuge**
In the final weeks before the new Congress is seated, the Trump administration is doing everything it can to push forward oil development in the irreplaceable Arctic National Wildlife Refuge. The administration is now moving to advance harmful seismic testing, the first step in oil development, that could destroy polar bear dens and habitat, scar the fragile tundra, and jeopardize Indigenous lifeways and subsistence traditions. The Gwich’in people are the original stewards of the Arctic Refuge, and LCV continues to stand with them in this fight. We’re calling on people across the country to take action to block seismic testing, protect polar bear habitat, and help defend one of our country’s last wild places.
[**_Speak Out Today: Protect Polar Bear Habitat in the Arctic Refuge!_**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/rNykfEag8~)
---
| | | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/~)
---
| | Peter,
---
| | In the final weeks before the new Congress is seated, the Trump administration is moving to advance oil development in the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge’s culturally and ecologically critical Coastal Plain — beginning with harmful seismic testing.
---
| | Seismic testing is the first step in oil development and requires massive trucks, some as heavy as 90,000 pounds, to pound the fragile Arctic tundra with powerful vibrations to search for oil. It leaves deep scars on the landscape that last for decades, and the noise and activity generated during testing disrupt wildlife migrations, causing fear and confusion that can lead animal mothers to abandon their young.
---
| | **Seismic testing destroys essential animal habitats and homes, including polar bear dens.** What’s more, the administration's recent change to the definition of "harm" under the Endangered Species Act revoked significant protections for polar bears and other species. The change means that if seismic testing crushes polar bear dens, destroying their homes and threatening their lives, there will be no repercussions for Big Oil.
---
| | [**_Add your voice today: protect polar bear habitat in the Arctic Refuge >>_**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/k_)
---
| | | [TAKE ACTION NOW](https://links.messages.lcv.)
---
| | We cannot let Trump and his Big Oil cronies destroy the irreplaceable Arctic Refuge in pursuit of dirty energy development. For decades, the Gwich'in people have led the movement to keep the Arctic Refuge free from corporate greed and extraction — no drilling, no development.
---
| | LCV stands with the Gwich’in people and opposes seismic testing on these sacred lands, and in the entire region. There are lasting consequences to pursuing oil development in this region — even before any drilling starts — that could have disastrous outcomes for Indigenous communities, wildlife, and our climate.
---
| | Nothing justifies developing one of the last wild places on earth. [**_Join LCV in sending a clear message to protect all life in the Arctic Refuge: no seismic testing!_**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/j9y2f0Nj-)
---
| | Thank you for standing with LCV and with all the protectors of the Arctic Refuge, so that this irreplaceable landscape may continue to thrive for future generations.
---
| | America Fitzpatrick
Conservation Program Director
League of Conservation Voters

body:
Happy Thanksgiving
| | | ****
---
---
|
---
| **Unsealed Records Reveal Broad Criminal Probe of Rep. Ilhan Omar****[](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86835&L=39269&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly95b3V0dS5iZS8ydU1QZlZCNE4wYz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&H=928c2013375c6578a1eda7bac4842ef910aff79d23747ceec87d6f051d7bc077)**
[Unsealed court records](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86835&L=39254&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL3Vuc2VhbC1vbWFyLXdhcnJhbnQtcmVjb3Jkcy0wMDE0NC8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE&H=48f9ff26824e47c85515e29dea37ea6259e60f99c895675350429d5ba2209f88) in our lawsuit over the October 12, 2026, search of Rep. Ilhan Omar’s (D-MN) Washington, DC, residence confirm a serious, wide-ranging federal criminal investigation of the congresswoman covering conduct from “1980 to the present.” The records also show that the U.S. Department of Justice continues to withhold a significant portion of the search warrant, its attachments, and the inventory of what agents seized, records that Omar and her lawyers already have copies of.The records were released on November 23, 2026, by [order](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86835&L=39239&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL29tYXItc2VhcmNoLXdhcnJhbnQtb3JkZXItMDAxNDQvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&H=80cfd4c4c51779cb550fb60ec48bd5d8fb81a853d074f558b21e38aa9785759e) of Chief Judge James E. Boasberg in the consolidated unsealing [proceeding](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86835&L=39197&F=H&&H=ac679f8a621403f076a73b94712f990e979cf93a922bff66bb759333617c172d) brought by Judicial Watch, _The New York Times_ , and fourteen press organizations (In re Application of Fourteen Press Organizations for Access to Sealed Search Warrant Records, No. 1:26-mc-00144 (D.D.C.)). While all three groups requested that the government file copies with Judge Boasberg to review, only Judicial Watch requested that the government also produce redacted versions of the records. More than half of the 169 pages released are entirely blacked out.The partially unsealed records show a serious criminal investigation concerning conduct going back decades:
* The investigation reaches back more than four decades. The warrant authorized a search for evidence of multiple “Target Offenses” involving “Ilhan Nur Said Elmi a/k/a Ilhan Abdullahi Omar,” occurring “between 1980 to the present.” The Justice Department told the court it believes Omar “has committed” crimes “over decades,” beginning long before she entered Congress. The specific statutes remain redacted.
* A federal judge found probable cause. Magistrate Judge Matthew J. Sharbaugh pressed the government for more on probable cause for two of the offenses before signing. The Justice Department responded that its application “supplies probable cause related to each of the Target Offenses, not just the two the Court flagged,” and the court signed the warrant on October 9, 2026.
* The magistrate judge held the warrant for a week. The Justice Department applied at approximately 10:33 a.m. on Friday, October 2, 2026, and asked the court to sign by Monday, October 5. After “several inquiries” from the government about the status, Judge Sharbaugh said he would get to it on October 6. That day, he raised the Speech or Debate Clause problem on his own, ordered two rounds of supplemental briefing, and required revisions to the warrant before signing it on October 9. None of the October 2 through October 6 activity appears on the court’s docket, which begins on October 7.
* Senior Justice Department officials are directly involved. The government’s filings are signed by an Associate Deputy Attorney General as well as senior leadership from the U.S. Attorney’s Office. The Acting Deputy Attorney General, the second most senior official at the Justice Department, personally handled outreach to the House before the search.
* Agents were authorized to seize Omar’s phones, computers, and records. The warrant reaches cellular phones “registered to or used by” Omar, computers and storage media, and any digital device “owned, used, or controlled by” Omar “or in proximity to evidence of the TARGET OFFENSES.”
* Others may be implicated. In seeking secrecy, the government warned that disclosure could prompt “potential subject(s)” to flee, destroy evidence, or “influence or intimidate potential witnesses.” The records do not say who else is under scrutiny.
* The investigation is ongoing and active. Homeland Security Investigations executed the warrant at approximately 6:05 a.m. on October 12. On October 16, the Justice Department told the court its investigation “is still in full swing.” On November 4, it said the warrant is still “not fully executed.”
* The court imposed special constitutional protections over the DOJ's objection. The Justice Department argued the Speech or Debate Clause did not apply to a search of Omar’s home. Judge Sharbaugh disagreed and required a special search protocol, Attachment C, before signing.
* The Justice Department pointed to an earlier, broader warrant against someone else. To argue for fewer protections, the Justice Department told Judge Sharbaugh that “[t]he Court recently signed a broader search warrant with fewer protections.” That warrant, signed weeks earlier, reached “the person, devices, and two private Washington, D.C. residences” of someone whose name is redacted, and included “zero special Speech or Debate procedures.” In making the comparison, the Justice Department cited authority that Speech or Debate immunity remains “available to a Member of Congress after he leaves office,” suggesting the earlier target was a current or former Member of Congress. A signed search warrant package attached as an exhibit to the DOJ's first brief, apparently from that search, is fully redacted.

Our work paid off – as now the public has more details on the serious criminal issues concerning Ilhan Omar. Those were the themes of the very first celebration.Life for the Pilgrims who arrived on these shores in December of 1620 was very hard, but nevertheless they stopped to celebrate their blessings. As the[ ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86835&L=11088&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cucGxpbW90aC5vcmcvbGVhcm4vanVzdC1raWRzL2hvbWV3b3JrLWhlbHAvd2hvLXdlcmUtcGlsZ3JpbXM/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE&H=57c8ec49e9a8dbc092fd9d03ccec0a831edc221a00f6c98f31151114656606ec)[Plimoth Plantation](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86835&L=11088&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cucGxpbW90aC5vcmcvbGVhcm4vanVzdC1raWRzL2hvbWV3b3JrLWhlbHAvd2hvLXdlcmUtcGlsZ3JpbXM/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE&H=57c8ec49e9a8dbc092fd9d03ccec0a831edc221a00f6c98f31151114656606ec) describes it:Many of the colonists fell ill. They were probably suffering from scurvy and pneumonia caused by a lack of shelter in the cold, wet weather. Although they were not starving, their sea-diet was very high in salt, which weakened their bodies on the long journey and during that first winter. As many as two or three people died each day during their first two months on land. Only 52 people survived the first year in Plymouth. When _Mayflower _left Plymouth on April 5, 1621, she was sailed back to England by only half of her crew.Nevertheless, a year after their arrival they sat down for a feast of thanksgiving. They had befriended and made a treaty of mutual protection with the Pokanoket Wampanoag leader, Ousamequin, also known as Massasoit to the Pilgrims.In the fall of 1621, the colonists marked their first harvest with a three-day celebration. Massasoit and 90 of his men joined the English for feasting and entertainment. In the 1800s this famous celebration became the basis for the story of the First Thanksgiving.It would be easy to focus on the passing difficulties of our time, especially for those of us who fight daily to preserve the God-given liberties that have blessed this land since the time of the Pilgrims. But, as they did, we must pause to reflect on all that is good and on the Source of this goodness.I am particularly fond of a[ ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86835&L=11089&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly9lbi53aWtpcGVkaWEub3JnL3dpa2kvQWRyaWFudXNfVmFsZXJpdXM/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE&H=d229b3a48cb138b38d8d486ff8c2c5556781790614719521f6f181da603c4de2)[hymn](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86835&L=11089&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly9lbi53aWtpcGVkaWEub3JnL3dpa2kvQWRyaWFudXNfVmFsZXJpdXM/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE&H=d229b3a48cb138b38d8d486ff8c2c5556781790614719521f6f181da603c4de2) popularly associated with Thanksgiving Day and often sung at family meals and religious services on this day, having been brought to America by Dutch settlers in New Amsterdam, now New York City. It was written by Adrianus Valerius and is entitled “ _Wilt Heden Nu Treden” (“We Gather Together.”)_ We gather together to ask the Lord’s blessing;
He chastens and hastens His will to make known.
The wicked oppressing now cease from distressing.
Sing praises to His Name; He forgets not His own.Beside us to guide us, our God with us joining,
Ordaining, maintaining His kingdom divine;
So from the beginning the fight we were winning;
Thou, Lord, were at our side, all glory be Thine!We all do extol Thee, Thou Leader triumphant,
And pray that Thou still our Defender will be.
Let Thy congregation escape tribulation;
Thy Name be ever praised! O Lord, make us free!All of us at Judicial Watch wish you and yours a most blessed Thanksgiving! I would be remiss if I also did not thank you, Dear Supporter, for you any and all support you’ve given Judicial Watch throughout the year. Of course, your special support now for Judicial Watch’s essential work would be most welcome. You can support us directly here!
Until next week,
